You gain attribute boosts from your Ancestry, your Background, and your Class. In addition, you gain four free attribute boosts that you can place anywhere you wish (although not twice in the same ability score).

Attribute Flaws

In addition to a boost, our Ancestry might also come with an Attribute Flaw, such as a malus to charisma for dwarves. You also have the option of reducing two of your attribute modifiers by 1 each to increase a third by 1, which is called a "Voluntary Flaw". Because this choice is made at the same time as your ancestry, it cannot be used to boost an attribute modifier which is already increased by your ancestry. Likewise, the flaw cannot be applied to an attribute which is already being reduced by your ancestry.

Attribute Boosts on Foundry

  PF2E System Wiki: Making a PC

The PF2E system on Foundry VTT makes it very simple to increase your ability scores as you build your character. Clicking on the Edit button next to your ability scores on your character sheet opens up a window which allows you to allocate your boosts and flaws. Any attribute boosts that are automatically granted by your ancestry or other choices you have made will be listed here, and any free boosts you have available can be selected from all legal options.

In addition, because the system automatically calculates and applies the appropriate modifiers for you, you will see your rolls account for your attribute modifiers without you needing to add them up yourself.

Ability Scores in the Beginner Box.name: 入门盒中的能力值 Ability Scores in the Beginner Box
Ability Scores in the Beginner Box.text:
入门盒中的能力值

  PF2E 系统 Wiki：创建角色 @UUID[JournalEntry.KIpNnMtah73eyPC8.JournalEntryPage.RRxNZiD64dvvpWYt]{创建你的角色}

正如 创建你的角色 讲义中所提到的，核心规则与入门盒中包含的精简规则在 角色 构建的细节上可能有很大差异。一如既往，如果有任何疑问，请务必询问你的 GM 你正在使用的是哪个版本的规则，并直接查阅规则书以获取最准确的信息。Foundry 的寻路者二版系统是在假设你使用核心规则的情况下运行的。如果你使用的是入门盒规则，这些日志讲义以及 职业 物品 的“详情”页签中的信息可能不适用于你的 角色。

入门盒精简核心规则的方法之一是移除了 能力 值的概念。相反，能力 提升会直接增加你的 调整值。因此，入门盒有时可能会让你将 能力 调整值 增加 1。这相当于一次 能力 提升，应该使你的 能力 值增加 2——这并不意味着你将数值增加 1（例如，从 10 增加到 11）。



原文:

Ability Scores in the Beginner Box

  PF2E System Wiki: Making a PC @UUID[JournalEntry.KIpNnMtah73eyPC8.JournalEntryPage.RRxNZiD64dvvpWYt]{Creating Your Hero}

As mentioned in the Creating Your Hero handout, the specifics of character building can vary wildly between the core rules and the more streamlined rules included within the Beginner Box. As always, if there is any doubt, make sure to ask your GM which version of the rules you're using, and to consult the rulebooks directly to get the facts straight from the source. The Pathfinder Second Edition system for Foundry operates under the assumption you are playing with the core rules. If you are using the Beginner Box rules, the information contained within these journal handouts and the class item's "details" tab may not apply to your character.

One of the ways in which the Beginner Box streamlines the core rules is by removing the concept of an ability score. Instead, Ability Boosts directly increase your modifier. As such, at times, the Beginner Box might tell you to increase your ability modifier by one. This is equivalent to an Ability Boost and should increase your ability scores by 2- it does not mean that you increase your score by one (for example, from 10 to 11).

Actions.name: 动作 Actions
Actions.text:
英雄通过使用动作来影响世界。一些被称为基础动作的动作可以被任何人使用——@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜索}、@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.Bcxarzksqt9ezrs6]{奔行}和@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.VjxZFuUXrCU94MWR]{打击}都是基础动作。其他动作，如法术和特殊能力，只能由特定角色使用。每个动作都会产生一个效果。有些动作会自动产生效果，而有些则需要你通过掷骰来决定效果。

动作图标

你会看到游戏中各种不同类型的动作使用了以下图标。

1单动作是最简单且最常见的动作。你可以在你的回合中以任何你喜欢的顺序使用3个单动作。

r 反应是特殊的动作，你可以在非你自己的回合中使用。每种反应都有一个触发，规定了你何时可以使用该反应。你每轮只能使用1个反应。

活动比单动作花费的时间更长。使用2个动作的活动带有此符号：  2。使用3个动作——即你的整个回合——的活动带有此符号 3。有些活动花费的时间甚至更长，你只能在战斗遭遇之间使用它们。

基础动作

每个生物都可以使用基础动作来完成普通任务。你会经常用到@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{交互}、@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.UHpkTuCtyaPqiCAB]{迈步}、@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.Bcxarzksqt9ezrs6]{奔行}和@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.VjxZFuUXrCU94MWR]{打击}。许多专长和其他动作会让你使用这些基础动作之一，或者修改它们以产生不同的效果。例如，大量的活动都包含一次打击。

只要你能行动，你也可以在不消耗任何动作的情况下说话。你通常每轮可以说话大约一句。手语的工作方式相同，但你需要空着手来做，且信息的接收者需要看到你而不是听到你。说话的特殊用途，例如尝试欺骗技能检定来@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{撒谎}，需要消耗动作并遵循其自身的规则。

探索时的动作

当你不在遭遇中时，你不需要追踪何时获得你的3个动作 and 反应，尽管你仍然可以根据需要使用动作和反应。GM会告诉你你有多少时间来完成事情，并在出现混淆时决定你可以使用哪些动作和反应。带有探索特征的活动需要很长的时间来执行，因此你只能在遭遇之外使用它们。



原文:

A hero affects the world by using actions. Some actions, called basic actions, can be used by anyone—@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek}, @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.Bcxarzksqt9ezrs6]{Stride}, and @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.VjxZFuUXrCU94MWR]{Strike} are all basic actions. Others, like spells and special abilities, can be used only by certain characters. Each action produces an effect. Some do this automatically, but for others you’ll roll to determine the effect.

Action Icons

You’ll see the following icons used for the different types of actions found throughout the game.

1 Single actions are the simplest and most common actions. You can use 3 single actions on your turn, in any order you want.

r Reactions are special actions that you can use when it isn’t your turn. Each reaction has a trigger that specifies when you can use that reaction. You can use only 1 reaction per round.

Activities take longer than a single action. Activities that use 2 actions have this symbol:  2. Activities that use 3 actions—your whole turn—have this symbol 3. Some activities take even longer, and you can use them only when you’re between combat encounters.

Basic Actions

Every creature can do common tasks using basic actions. You’ll @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{Interact}, @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.UHpkTuCtyaPqiCAB]{Step}, @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.Bcxarzksqt9ezrs6]{Stride}, and @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.VjxZFuUXrCU94MWR]{Strike} a great deal. Many feats and other actions tell you to use one of these basic actions or modify them to produce different effects. For example, a large number of activities include a Strike.

As long as you can act, you can also speak without spending any actions. You can usually speak a single sentence or so per round. Sign language works the same way, but you need free hands to do it, and the recipient of your message needs to see you rather than hear you. Special uses of speech, such as attempting a Deception skill check to @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie}, require spending actions and follow their own rules.

Actions While Exploring

When you’re not in an encounter, you don’t have to track when you get your 3 actions and reaction, though you can still use actions and reactions as needed. The GM tells you how much time you have to get things done and determine what actions and reactions you can use if there’s confusion. Activities with the exploration trait take a long time to carry out, so you can use them only outside of encounters.

Areas.name: 区域 Areas
Areas.text:
某些效果会占据特定形状和体型的区域。区域有三种类型：爆发、锥形和线形。通常情况下，具有区域的能力会影响区域内的所有人。例如，如果你施放@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.y6rAdMK6EFlV6U0t]{燃烧之手}法术，其锥形区域内的所有人——无论是盟友还是敌人！——都必须进行一次反射豁免，如果失败，他们将受到火焰伤害。如果一个生物位于区域内，但完全处于障碍物之后（例如位于区域源点另一侧的墙后），则不受该效果的影响。

爆发：从中心向外扩展的球体。你可以将爆发的中心设置在射程内的任何网格交点上。

锥形：从你身上射出的四分之一圆。在使用该能力时，选择将锥形直向射出还是沿对角线射出。

线形：从你所在方格的一个角向你选择的方向射出的直线。

测量模板

 知识库：测量与模板

Foundry VTT 提供了一个实用的模板功能，允许你放置区域效果。模板形状包括圆形、锥形、矩形和射线——涵盖了寻路者系统的所有需求。此外，《寻路者》第二版中的许多法术都预先配置了它们的区域，并且在法术卡中会有一个按钮，让你能够轻松放置模板！

如果你想手动放置模板，也可以使用工具栏中的“测量控制”。你放置的模板会自动着色，以匹配你分配的玩家颜色。

要删除已放置的模板，只需将鼠标悬停在其放置图标上并按 delete 键即可。



原文:

Some effects occupy an area of a specified shape and size. There are three types of areas: bursts, cones, and lines. Usually, an ability with an area affects everyone in the area. For instance, if you cast the @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.y6rAdMK6EFlV6U0t]{Burning Hands} spell, everyone in its cone- friend or foe!- must attempt a Reflex save, and if they fail, they take fire damage. A creature that's inside the area but totally behind a barrier, such as on the other side of a wall from your area's origin, isn't affected by the effect.

Burst: A sphere expanding out from the center. You can set the center of the burst on any grid intersection in range.

Cone: A quarter-circle shoots out from you. Choose whether to aim the cone straight out from you or diagonally when you use the ability.

Line: A straight line shoots from a corner of your square in a direction you choose.

Measured Templates

 Knowledge Base: Measurement and Templates

Foundry VTT provides a useful Templates feature that allows you to place area effects. There are template shapes for circles, cones, rectangles, and rays- covering all of the needs of the Pathfinder system. In addition, many of the spells in Pathfinder Second Edition come preconfigured with their areas, and will have a button in the spellcard that allows you to easily place a template!

If you'd like to place a template manually, you can also use "Measurement Controls" from the toolbar. Templates that you place are automatically colored to match your assigned player color.

To delete a template that you have placed, simply hover over its placement icon and press delete.

Carrying and using Items.name: 携带并使用物品 Carrying and using Items
Carrying and using Items.text:
你可以通过三种方式携带物品：手持、穿戴或收纳。手持物品就在你的手中。你可以在每只手中各持有一件 物品，或者用双手持有一件双手 物品。穿戴物品塞在口袋、腰包、武装带、武器 鞘等地方。你可以花费一个动作取出 穿戴物品，而将其放回则需要另一个动作。通常情况下，操纵物体使用交互 基础动作。你可以 丢下物品 而无需花费动作。收纳物品放在背包或类似的容器中，你必须先花费一个动作脱下背包，然后才能花费交互动作取出其中收纳的 物品。

Foundry中的手持 物品

你可以通过点击物品栏中 角色 拥有的 物品 旁的图标来控制其手持或穿戴状态，这允许你在手持、穿戴、丢弃等状态间进行选择。将 物品 设定 为“手持”将启用某些功能，例如让 武器 的打击出现在你的 动作 标签页中，或者在火把的情况下创建一个光照 效果。

许多使用物品的方式需要你花费多个 动作。例如，使用挂在腰带鞘里的匕首进行打击，需要先使用一个交互动作拔出匕首，然后再使用第二个动作进行打击。同样地，你必须先从口袋或腰包中取出药剂，然后才能通过交互动作饮用它。

手

表格中每个 物品 的条目都说明了使用该 物品 需要多少只手。大多数需要双手的物品可以仅用单手携带，但你必须花费一个交互动作来改变握持方式才能使用该 物品。GM可能会判定某个 物品 太大而无法单手携带（对于特别巨大的物品，甚至无法双手携带）。

穿戴工具

你可以通过穿戴 工具包（例如登山套件或医者 工具包）使其更易于使用。这允许你在使用工具的动作中包含取出和放回工具的过程。任何未以此方式穿戴的工具包必须处于收纳状态，或通过交互动作取出。



原文:

You can carry items in three ways: held, worn, or stowed. Held items are in your hands. You can hold one item in each hand or one two-handed item using both hands. Worn items are tucked into pockets, belt pouches, bandoliers, weapon sheaths, and so forth. You can retrieve a worn item with a single action, and putting it back uses another action. As usual, manipulating objects uses the Interact basic action. You can drop an item without spending an action. Stowed items are in a backpack or a similar container, and you have to spend an action to take off the backpack before you can spend the Interact action to retrieve an item stowed within.

Held Items in Foundry

You can control how an item your character owns is held or worn by clicking on the hand icon beside it in your inventory, which allows you to choose between held, worn, dropped, and so on. Setting an item as "held" will enable certain functions, like making the weapon's strike appear on your actions tab, or creating a light effect in the case of a torch.

Many ways of using items require you to spend multiple actions. For example, making a Strike with a dagger worn in a sheath at your belt requires using an Interact action to draw the dagger and then using a second action to Strike. Likewise, you have to draw a potion from your pocket or belt pouch before you can Interact to drink it.

Hands

Each item’s entry on the table says how many hands it takes to use the item. Most items that require two hands can be carried in only one hand, but you must spend an Interact action to change your grip in order to use the item. The GM may determine that an item is too big to carry in one hand (or even two hands, for particularly large items).

Wearing Tools

You can make a toolkit (such as a climbing kit or healer's toolkit) easier to use by wearing it. This allows you to draw and replace the tools as part of the action that uses them. Any toolkits not worn in this manner must be stowed or taken out with an Interact action.

Currency and Expenses.name: 货币和出费 Currency and Expenses
Currency and Expenses.text:
在开拓者中，现金的标准形式是硬币，分为三种类型：铜币 (cp)、银币 (sp) 和金币 (gp)。一枚银币价值 10 cp，是大多数日常交易的标准。金币通常用于购买魔法物品和其他昂贵物品，因为 1 枚金币价值 10 sp 或 100 cp。

买卖

随着你获得经验和额外的财富，你应该定期购买新的装备。在冒险过程中，你可能还会发现装备甚至魔法物品，或者在你有足够的钱后购买它们。你通常只能在聚居地购买装备；GM 会让你知道什么时候是疯狂购物的时代！

你也可以卖掉不再使用的装备。大多数物品可以按其价格的一半出售，但损坏的盾牌根本无法出售。

生活开销

下表显示了维持生计所需的费用。这些数值掩蔽了食宿、税收和其他费用。

原文:

The standard form of currency in Pathfinder is coinage, which comes in three types: copper pieces (cp), silver pieces (sp), and gold pieces (gp). A silver piece is worth 10 cp and is the standard for most everyday transactions. Gold pieces are often used for purchasing magic items and other expensive items, as 1 gold piece is worth 10 sp or 100 cp.

Buying and Selling

As you gain experience and additional wealth, you should periodically buy new equipment. You might also find equipment or even magic items during your adventures, or you can buy them once you have enough money. You can usually buy equipment only in settlements; the GM will let you know when it’s time for a shopping spree!

You can also sell equipment you aren’t using anymore. Most items can be sold for half their Price, but broken shields can’t be sold at all.

Hit Points, Healing, and Dying.name: 生命值、治疗与死亡 Hit Points, Healing, and Dying
Hit Points, Healing, and Dying.text:
你的最大生命值代表了你在健康且休息充分时的健康状况、耐力以及英雄气概。当你受到伤害时，从你当前的生命值中减去该伤害。

某些法术、物品和其他效果可以治疗你，彻夜休息也能治疗你。当你获得治疗时，你恢复等同于治疗量的生命值。你通常无法超过你的最大生命值。

被击败

生物的生命值不能低于0。大多数生命值降至0的敌人会死亡或被摧毁。这会将他们从游戏中移除。然而，如果该攻击是非致命的，敌人就不会死亡，而是会被被击败一段相当长的时间（通常为1分钟或更久）。

另一方面，英雄在生命值触及 0时不会自动死亡！相反，他们会被被击败——但他们仍有死亡的危险。

当你被击败时，会有两种特殊状态发挥作用。

@Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{濒死}: 这种状态包含一个数值，用于衡量你离死亡有多近。当你触及濒死 4时，你就会死亡！

@Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{受伤}: 当你被击败并恢复过来后，你会处于更大的危险中。受伤状态会让你的濒死状态恶化得更快。

当你的生命值降至0时，你会被被击败并产生以下效果。

• 立即将你的先攻顺位移动到使你生命值降至0的那个回合之前。

• 你获得 @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{濒死 1} 状态。如果导致你被击败的效果是攻击者的大成功或大失败成功，或者是你自己的大成功或大失败失败结果，你改为获得濒死 2 状态。如果该伤害是由非致命攻击或效果造成的，你不会获得濒死状态；你改为获得昏迷状态并拥有0点生命值。

• 你倒下并掉落手中持有的物品。你获得 @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{俯卧} 状态和 @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{昏迷} 状态。昏迷状态在边栏中有描述。当你的生命值为0时，你无法失去昏迷状态。

濒死

如果你因任何原因触及濒死 4，你会立即死亡。如果你在已经拥有濒死状态时受到伤害，你的濒死值增加1；如果该伤害来自攻击者的大成功或大失败命中或你自己的大成功或大失败失败，则增加2。如果你从0点生命值恢复到1点或更多，你会自动失去濒死状态并苏醒。每当你失去濒死状态时，你都会获得下文描述的受伤状态。

当你拥有濒死状态时，在你每个回合开始时，你必须进行一次 @UUID[.DyVmklA6nwuY8sgU#special-rules-for-checks]{纯骰检定}（不加任何修正的d20投骰），DC等于10 + 你当前的濒死值，以确定你的情况是好转还是恶化。这被称为复苏检定。根据你的复苏检定结果使用以下效果。

大成功：濒死值减少2。

成功：濒死值减少1。

失败：濒死值增加1。

大失败：濒死值增加1。如果你拥有受伤状态，你会立即死亡。

恢复

如果你通过复苏检定成功而失去了濒死状态，你仍然处于0点生命值并保持昏迷，但你可以按照 @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{昏迷} 状态中的描述苏醒。正如任何时间你从濒死中恢复一样，你获得受伤状态。

受伤

当你拥有濒死状态并失去它时，无论出于何种原因，你都会获得 @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{受伤 1} 状态。如果你已经拥有受伤状态，当你失去濒死状态时，其数值增加1。

受伤状态使得被击败变得更加危险：如果你在受伤时获得濒死状态，将濒死状态的数值增加等同于你受伤值的数值。

如果你有足够的时间，你可以摆脱受伤状态。如果有人通过使用医疗技能进行“治疗伤口”成功为你恢复了生命值，或者如果你恢复到最大生命值并休息了10分钟，该状态就会消失，无论其当前数值是多少。



原文:

Your maximum Hit Points represents your health, wherewithal, and heroic drive when you’re in good health and rested. When you take damage, subtract the damage from your current Hit Points.

Some spells, items, and other effects can heal you, and resting overnight heals you, too. When you’re healed, you regain Hit Points equal to the amount healed. You usually can’t go above your maximum Hit Points.

Getting Knocked Out

Creatures can’t have fewer than 0 Hit Points. Most enemies who fall to 0 Hit Points die or are destroyed. This removes them from play. If the attack was nonlethal, though, the enemy doesn’t die, and they’re instead knocked out for a significant amount of time (usually 1 minute or more).

Heroes, on the other hand, don’t automatically die when they reach 0 Hit Points! Instead, they’re knocked out—but they’re still at risk of death.

Two special conditions come into play in when you’re knocked out.

@Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}: This condition includes a number that measures how close you are to death. You die when you reach dying 4!

@Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded}: When you get knocked out and come back, you’re in greater danger. The wounded condition makes your dying condition get worse faster.

When you’re reduced to 0 Hit Points, you’re knocked out with the following effects.

• Immediately move your initiative position to directly before the turn in which you were reduced to 0 HP.

• You gain the @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying 1} condition. If the effect that knocked you out was a critical success from the attacker or the result of your critical failure, you gain the dying 2 condition instead. If the damage was dealt by a nonlethal attack or effect, you don’t gain the dying condition; you instead gain the unconscious condition and have 0 Hit Points.

• You fall down and drop what you’re holding. You gain the @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} condition and the @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} condition. The unconscious condition is described in the sidebar. You can’t lose the unconscious condition while you have 0 HP.

Dying

If you ever reach dying 4 for any reason, you die immediately. If you take damage while you already have the dying condition, you increase your dying value by 1, or by 2 if the damage came from an attacker’s critical hit or your own critical failure. If you ever go from 0 HP to 1 HP or more, you automatically lose the dying condition and wake up. Anytime you lose the dying condition, you gain the wounded condition, described below.

When you have the dying condition, at the start of each of your turns, you must attempt a @UUID[.DyVmklA6nwuY8sgU#special-rules-for-checks]{Flat Check} (a d20 roll without adding anything) against a DC equal to 10 + your current dying value to see if you get better or worse. This is called a recovery check. Use the following effects for your recovery check result.

Critical Success: Reduce your dying value by 2.

Success: Reduce your dying value by 1.

Failure: Increase your dying value by 1.

Critical Failure: Increase your dying value by 1. If you have the wounded condition, you die immediately.

Recovering

If you lose the dying condition by succeeding at a recovery check, you’re still at 0 Hit Points and remain unconscious, but you can wake up as described in the @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} condition. As with any time you recover from dying, you gain the wounded condition.

Wounded

When you have the dying condition and lose it, regardless of the reason, you gain the @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded 1} condition. If you already had the wounded condition, increase its value by 1 when you lose the dying condition.

The wounded condition makes getting knocked out more dangerous: if you gain the dying condition while wounded, increase the dying condition’s value by your wounded value.

If you have enough time, you can get rid of the wounded condition. The condition goes away, regardless of its current value, if someone successfully restores Hit Points to you by using the Medicine skill to Treat Wounds or if you’re restored to your maximum Hit Points and rest for 10 minutes.

Movement.name: 移动 Movement
Movement.text:
网格与移动控制

 知识库：玩家导向 - 场景导航

Foundry VTT 在场景上渲染了一个网格，它提供了自动吸附和移动距离追踪功能。通常在开拓者（Pathfinder）中，单个网格方格等于 5 英尺，即一个中型生物（如每位英雄）所占据的空间。小型生物也占据这一空间，但开拓者系统通常会略微缩小其 Token 的比例，以直观地提示其较小的体型。大型生物占据 2x2 方格的空间，且每增加一个体型等级，该空间在两个次元上都会增加 1。

Foundry VTT 提供了多种移动受控 Token 的方式，但最常用的是使用键盘上的方向键，或者点击并拖动 Token 从一个位置到另一个位置。在遭遇战或其他移动受限的情况下，你可以通过按住 Ctrl 键、点击你的 Token，并在前往目的地的途中多次点击来放置路径点，以此测量你的移动。这将显示该移动所掩蔽的距离测量。在显示测量结果时按下空间键将执行移动，你的 Token 将沿着路径点行进至目的地。

困难地形

每当生物需要穿过难以移动的地形（如积雪或灌木丛）时，你可以使用困难地形规则。进入困难地形需要额外花费 5 英尺的移动。

对移动的反应

某些反应是由生物使用带有移动特征的动作触发的。最著名的例子是反应打击（Reactive Strike），战士和某些怪物拥有此能力。拥有反应打击的生物可以在附近的敌人使用带有移动特征的动作，或敌人离开附近的方格时使用它。快步（Step）基础动作不会触发基于移动的反应，由其他生物造成的移动（如推离 Shove）也不会。

穿过生物移动

你可以穿过任何愿意让你通过的生物的空间。如果你想穿过一个不愿意的生物的空间，你可以使用特技（Acrobatics）来翻滚穿过（Tumble Through）该生物的空间。你不能在另一个生物占据的方格中结束你的回合，但你可以在其方格中结束一个移动动作，前提是你立即使用另一个移动动作离开该方格。如果两个生物意外地停留在同一个方格中，GM 将决定哪一个被强行移出方格（或者其中一个是否摔倒并获得 @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{俯卧 状态}）。

如果一个俯卧的生物是自愿的、无意识的或死亡的，且其体型等于或小于你，你可以与其站在同一个方格中。在某些情况下，GM 可能会允许你爬上一个死亡或无意识的更大型生物。

坠落

当你坠落超过 5 英尺时，着陆时你会受到等同于坠落距离一半的钝击伤害。如果你因坠落受到任何伤害，你就会摔倒并获得俯卧状态。

你可以使用反应动作抓牢边缘（Grab an Edge）来减少某些坠落造成的伤害。进行一次反射豁免，对抗攀爬该表面的 DC（由 GM 选择）。如果你成功，你抓住了自己，受到的伤害如同坠落距离缩短了 20 英尺（若大成功或大失败成功则缩短 30 英尺）。若大成功或大失败失败，你每坠落 20 英尺就会受到 10 点钝击伤害，然后继续坠落！

在网格上移动

当一个角色在网格上移动时，游戏世界中游戏区域的每一个方格都是 5 英尺宽。

因为沿对角线移动覆盖的地面更多，所以计算该移动的方式有所不同。你在一个回合中进行的第一个对角线移动方格计为 5 英尺，但第二个计为 10 英尺，此后你的计数在这两者之间交替。 

在这个例子中，瓦莱洛斯进行行进（Stride），因此他最多可以移动等同于其速度的距离，即 25 英尺。他水平移动了 5 英尺，然后他的第一个对角线移动又花费了 5 英尺。现在他的第二个对角线移动要花费 10 英尺！对于最后一格移动，再进行一次对角线移动将花费 5 英尺，但水平移动进入碎石堆将花费 10 英尺，因为碎石堆是困难地形。如果瓦莱洛斯改为向上或向下移动，他可以移动 1 格。



原文:

Grids and Movement Controls

 Knowledge Base: Player Orientation - Navigating a Scene

Foundry VTT renders a grid on scenes which provides automatic snapping and tracking of movement distances. Typically in Pathfinder, a single grid square is equal to 5 feet, the space a Medium creature (like each of the heroes) would occupy. Small creatures also occupy this space, but typically have tokens scaled down just slightly by the Pathfinder System to give a visual cue of their smaller size. Large creatures occupy a space of 2x2 squares, and each size increments this space by 1 in both dimensions.

Foundry VTT provides a number of ways to move a controlled token, but the most common is to use the arrow keys on your keyboard or to click and drag the token from one position to another. During encounters or other times when movement is limited, you can measure your movements by holding the ctrl key, clicking your token, and placing waypoints on the way to your destination by clicking as many times as you'd like. This will display a measurement of the distance that move would cover. Pressing the space bar while the measurement is visible will execute the move, and your token will progress through the way points to your destination.

Difficult Terrain

Whenever creatures need to cross terrain that’s hard to move through, such as snow or underbrush, you can use the rules for difficult terrain. Difficult terrain costs 5 more feet of movement to move into.

Reactions to Movement

Some reactions are triggered by a creature using an action with the move trait. The most notable example is Reactive Strike, which fighters and some monsters have. A creature with Reactive Strike can use it when a nearby enemy uses an action with the move trait or when an enemy leaves a nearby square. The Step basic action doesn’t trigger reactions based on movement and neither does movement caused by other creatures, like a Shove.

Moving Through a Creature

You can move through the space of any creature willing to let you. If you want to move through an unwilling creature’s space, you can Tumble Through that creature’s space using Acrobatics. You can’t end your turn in a square occupied by another creature, though you can end a move action in its square provided that you immediately use another move action to leave that square. If two creatures end up in the same square by accident, the GM determines which one is forced out of the square (or whether one falls over and gains the @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone condition}).

You can stand in the same square as a prone creature if that creature is willing, unconscious, or dead and is your size or smaller. The GM might allow you to climb atop a larger creature that’s dead or unconscious in some situations.

Falling

When you fall more than 5 feet, upon landing you take bludgeoning damage equal to half the distance you fell. If you take any damage from a fall, you fall over and gain the prone condition.

You can Grab an Edge as a reaction to reduce the damage from some falls. Roll a Reflex save against the DC to Climb the surface (as chosen by the GM). If you succeed, you catch yourself and take damage as though the fall were 20 feet shorter (or 30 feet shorter on a critical success). On a critical failure, you take 10 bludgeoning damage for every 20 feet you’ve fallen, then keep falling!

Moving on a Grid

When a character moves on a grid, every square of the play area is 5 feet across in the game world.

Because moving diagonally covers more ground, you count that movement differently. The first square of diagonal movement you make in a turn counts as 5 feet, but the second counts as 10 feet, and your count thereafter alternates between the two. 

In this example, Valeros Strides so he can move up to his Speed, which is 25 feet. He moves 5 feet horizontally, then his first diagonal costs 5 more feet. Now his second diagonal costs 10 feet! For the last square of movement, taking another diagonal would take 5 feet, but moving horizontally into the rubble would take 10 feet because the rubble is difficult terrain. If Valeros moved up or down instead, he could move 1 square.

What's a Roleplaying Game?.name: 什么是角色扮演游戏？ What's a Roleplaying Game?
What's a Roleplaying Game?.text:
Pathfinder是一款桌面角色扮演游戏（RPG）——这是一个互动故事，其中一名玩家，即游戏管理者（GM），负责布置场景并提出挑战，而其他玩家则各自扮演英雄角色并尝试克服这些挑战。每位玩家都根据其角色的性格和能力对各种情况做出反应，描述他们的动作，随着每个场景进入下一个场景，从而为故事做出贡献。你将通过掷骰子来决定你的英雄在尝试动作时是成功还是失败，这增加了一个随机元素，然后加上你英雄的统计数据，这些数据代表了他们的实力。

叙述动作

Pathfinder不仅仅关乎数字。你和你的朋友们正在合作讲述一个故事！当你准备使用你的动作时，描述你角色的态度以及他们想要完成的事情。谈谈你如何执行你的攻击，或者你在施放法术时使用的华丽移动。GM也可以对怪物做同样的事情。

骰子

 知识库：骰子

Pathfinder使用一套六种不同类型的骰子。每种骰子都有不同的面数——四面、六面、八面或更多。每种骰子的名称都使用字母“d”，后跟骰子的面数。

当游戏要求你掷多个骰子时，“d”之前的数字会告诉你需要掷多少个该种骰子。例如，“4d6”意味着你应该掷四次d6并将结果相加。有时你会从你的掷骰总数中加上一个数字，有时你会从总数中减去一个数字。

在 Foundry 虚拟桌面（Foundry Virtual Tabletop）中，你可以通过在聊天窗口输入类似 /r 1d20 的命令来手动掷出这些数字，让你无需实物骰子即可快速模拟掷骰（或任意数量的骰子）的行为。欲了解更多信息，你可以阅读上方链接文章中关于骰子的内容。由于官方的 Pathfinder 第二版游戏系统提供了许多自动化功能，使掷骰变得更快、更简单，许多与特定动作相关的掷骰只需点击你的角色卡上的按钮即可完成。



原文:

Pathfinder is a tabletop roleplaying game (RPG)— an interactive story where one player, the Game Master (GM), sets the scene and presents challenges, while the other players each take the role of a hero and attempt to overcome those challenges. Every player contributes to the story by responding to situations according to the personality and abilities of their character, describing their actions as each scene leads into the next. You'll determine whether your hero succeeds or fails at the actions they attempt by rolling dice, which adds an element of chance, and then adding your hero's statistics, which represent their strengths.

Narrating Actions

Pathfinder’s about more than just numbers. You and your friends are cooperating to tell a story! As you prepare to use your actions, describe your character's attitude and what they want to get done. Talk about how you execute your attack or the flashy movement you use as you cast your spell. The GM can do the same for the monsters.

Dice

 Knowledge Base: Dice

Pathfinder uses a set of six different kinds of dice. Each die has a different number of sides- four, six, eight, or more. The name of each die uses the letter "d" followed by the number of sides on the die.

When the game tells you to roll multiple dice, the number before the "d" tells you how many of that die to roll. For example, "4d6" means you should roll a d6 four times and add the results together. Sometimes you'll add a number to the total from your die roll, and sometimes you'll subtract a number from the total.

In Foundry Virtual Tabletop, you can manually roll any of these numbers by entering a command such as /r 1d20 in the chat window, allowing you to quickly replicate the act of rolling a die (or any number of dice) without the need for physical dice to roll. For more information, you can read more about dice in the linked article above. Since the official Pathfinder Second Edition game system provides a lot of automated features to make dice rolling faster and easier, many die rolls associated with particular actions can be performed by simply clicking a button on your character sheet.

Basic Concepts.name: 基础概念 Basic Concepts
Basic Concepts.text:
阅读规则

在本模组中，数值和动作（如力量和打击）的首字母大写，以使其更加醒目。使用斜体格式的文本指的是法术或魔法物品，例如光亮术或治疗药水，以便于立即识别。

在创建英雄并开始游戏时，你会看到诸如“豁免检定”和“生命值”之类的游戏术语。你现在只需要对这些术语有一个大致的了解，稍后会对它们进行更详细的解释。

护甲职业 (AC)

这个数值是针对攻击的难度职业。它代表了在战斗中击中英雄或怪物的难度。

攻击

当一个生物试图伤害另一个生物时，它会进行一次打击或使用其他攻击动作。该动作掷骰成功被称为击中，而大成功或大失败成功有时被称为暴击。英雄可以使用武器或拳头进行打击，用双手进行擒抱，或者使用法术进行攻击。在你的回合中进行多次攻击会随着每次攻击而变得更加困难，这会给你带来一种被称为多重攻击减值的减值。

加值与减值

加值和减值适用于检定和某些数值。加值和减值有几种类型。如果你有多个相同类型的加值，你只使用最高的一个。同样，每种类型你只使用最差的一个减值。

状态

一种改变生物行动方式或改变其某些数值的持续性效果被称为状态。

持续时间

某些动作的效果持续时间比动作本身更长。这些效果通过持续时间来衡量。某些效果可能会持续到你下一个回合结束，持续1分钟，或持续其他长度。一旦持续时间结束，效果就会消失。

当持续时间以轮为单位衡量时，剩余的持续时间会在创建该效果的生物的每个回合开始时减少1。如果你需要在战斗中追踪持续1分钟的效果，1分钟就是10轮。大多数战斗不会持续那么久，所以你可能不需要担心！某些持续时间会持续到某些事情发生或停止发生，而不是持续一段特定的时代。

专长

专长是你的英雄可以使用的能力。它可能来自他们的族裔、背景或职业。某些专长赋予了使用特殊动作的能力。

生命值 (HP)

生命值代表了一个生物在昏迷并开始死亡之前可以受多重的伤。伤害按1比1的比例减少生命值，而治疗按同样的比例恢复生命值。

等级

等级是衡量综合实力的数值。本书中的规则可以将英雄提升到3等级，而《玩家核心》规则书中的规则可以将他们一路提升到20等级！生物、物品和其他规则元素也有等级，告诉你它们彼此之间的强弱程度。

非玩家角色 (NPC)

非玩家角色由GM控制。NPC与玩家互动并帮助推动故事发展。

察觉

察觉衡量你的英雄发现隐藏物体或异常情况的能力，并且通常决定了他们在战斗中投入行动的速度。

熟练度

熟练度衡量你的英雄对每项数值的资质。它有三个等级：未受训、受训和专家。如果你是未受训，你的熟练度加值为+0。如果你是受训，你的熟练度加值等于你的等级加2，如果你是专家，你的熟练度加值等于你的等级加4。

等阶

法术具有等阶以决定其综合威力。本书中的法术是1阶或2阶，但在《玩家核心》规则书中存在更强大的法术。

轮

一轮代表战斗遭遇中大约6秒的时代，在此期间所有参与者都有机会行动。

豁免检定 (豁免)

某些危险效果允许你尝试豁免检定以减轻其伤害。你会自动尝试豁免检定——你不需要使用动作或反应动作。

豁免检定有三种类型：强韧（抵抗疾病和毒素）、反射（躲避可以闪避的效果）以及意志（抵抗目标为心灵的效果）。

基础豁免检定

某些法术使用“基础豁免检定”。这些检定的运作方式与其他豁免相同，但使用相同的成功度：

大成功或大失败成功：该生物不受到伤害。

成功：该生物受到一半所列的伤害。

失败：该生物受到全部所列的伤害。

大成功或大失败失败：该生物受到双倍所列的伤害。

速度

速度是一个生物使用单个动作可以移动的距离。

特征

特征是出现在动作上的关键词，以便其他规则可以通过引用该特征与之交互。例如，战士可以对使用带有操纵或移动特征动作的人进行反应打击。特征出现在规则元素标题下方的方框中，或者出现在数据表中动作后的括号内。



原文:

Reading Rules

Throughout this module, statistics and actions like Strength and Strike are capitalized to help them stand out. Text that is formatted using italics refers to a spell or magic item, such as light or a healing potion, to help make it instantly recognizable.

You'll see game terms like "saving throw" and "Hit Points" as you create a hero and start playing the game. You need only a general idea of these terms for now, and they’re explained more later on.

Armor Class (AC)

This number is the Difficulty Class for an attack. It represents how hard it is to hit a hero or a monster in combat.

Attack

When a creature tries to harm another creature, it makes a Strike or uses some other attack action. A success on the roll for that action is called a hit, and a critical success is sometimes called a critical hit. A hero might Strike with a weapon or their fist, grapple with their hands, or attack with a spell. Attacking more than once on your turn gets harder with each attack, giving you a penalty called a multiple attack penalty.

Bonuses and Penalties

Bonuses and penalties apply to checks and certain statistics. There are several types of bonuses and penalties. If you have more than one bonus of the same type, you use only the highest one. Likewise, you use only the worst penalty of each type.

Condition

An ongoing effect that changes how a creature can act, or that alters some of their statistics, is called a condition.

Durations

Some actions have effects that last longer than the actions themselves. These effects are measured by a duration. Something might last until the end of your next turn, for 1 minute, or for other lengths. Once the duration is over, the effect ends.

When a duration is measured in rounds, the remaining duration decreases by 1 at the start of each turn of the creature that created the effect. If you need to track something that lasts 1 minute in combat, 1 minute is 10 rounds. Most fights don’t last that long, so you might not need to worry about it! Some durations last until certain things happen or stop happening, instead of a certain amount of time.

Feat

A feat is an ability your hero can use. It might come from their ancestry, background, or class. Some feats grant the ability to use special actions.

Hit Points (HP)

Hit Points represent how badly injured a creature can be before it falls unconscious and begins dying. Damage decreases Hit Points on a 1-to-1 basis, while healing restores Hit Points at the same rate.

Level

A level is a number that measures overall power. The rules in this book can take a hero to 3rd level, and those in the Player Core rulebook elevate them all the way to 20th level! Creatures, items, and other rules elements also have levels, telling you how powerful they are compared to one another.

Nonplayer Character (NPC)

A nonplayer character is controlled by the GM. NPCs interact with players and help advance the story.

Perception

Perception measures your hero's ability to notice hidden objects or unusual situations and usually determines how quickly they spring into action in combat.

Proficiency

Proficiency measures your hero’s aptitude for each statistic. It has three ranks: untrained, trained, and expert. If you're untrained, your proficiency bonus is +0. If you’re trained, your proficiency bonus equals your level plus 2, and if you’re an expert, your proficiency bonus equals your level plus 4.

Rank

Spells have a rank to determine their overall power. The spells in this book are 1st or 2nd rank, but more powerful spells exist in the Player Core rulebook.

Round

A round represents about 6 seconds of time during a combat encounter in which all participants get a chance to act.

Saving Throw (Save)

Some dangerous effects let you attempt a saving throw to mitigate their harm. You attempt a saving throw automatically- you don't have to use an action or a reaction.

There are three types of saving throws: Fortitude (to resist diseases and poisons), Reflex (to evade effects that can be dodged), and Will (to resist effects that target the mind).

Basic Saving Throw

Some spells use a "basic saving throw". These work like any other save but use the same degrees of success:

Critical Success: The creature takes no damage.

Success: The creature takes half the listed damage.

Failure: The creature takes the full listed damage.

Critical Failure: The creature takes double the listed damage.

Speed

Speed is the distance a creature can move using a single action.

Trait

A trait is a keyword that appears on an action so other rules can interact with it by referencing the trait. For instance, a fighter can make an Reactive Strike against someone who uses an action with the manipulate or move trait. Traits appear in boxes beneath the title of a rules element, or in parentheses following an action in a stat block.

Damage.name: 伤害 Damage
Damage.text:
如果你进行一次攻击并命中，或者你成功施放了一个法术来伤害你的敌人，你将投掷骰子来决定你对敌人造成了多少伤害。投掷你的武器或法术所指定的骰子种类和数量，并加上该能力所列出的任何数值（例如，许多武器说明在近战打击的伤害中加上你的力量）。

你造成的伤害具有一种类型，例如穿刺或火焰，这很重要，因为某些生物会根据类型受到更多或更少的伤害。

你造成的伤害会减少目标等量的生命值，因此一个受到6点伤害的生物会失去6点生命值。如果对攻击的减值将其伤害降低到0或更低，你仍然会造成1点伤害。例如，如果你投掷一把匕首，在伤害投骰中掷出1，而你的伤害投骰有-1的减值，你仍然会对你的目标造成1点伤害。

翻倍与减半

你可能需要将你的伤害翻倍或减半，这取决于你使用的动作。例如，许多法术在你的敌人豁免成功时造成一半伤害，失败时造成全部伤害，而在大失败时造成双倍伤害。你在投骰后进行伤害的翻倍或减半，而不是改变你投掷的骰子数量。在翻倍或减半之前加上任何加值或减值。特殊伤害——例如游荡者的偷袭攻击——也会被翻倍或减半。如果你将奇数的伤害减半，请向下取整。

持续伤害

持续伤害，如流血或着火，会随着时代推移对你造成伤害。当你获得持续伤害时，你不会立即受到伤害。相反，你在每轮自己的回合结束时受到伤害。在你受到伤害后，你尝试一次DC 15的纯骰检定（在d20投骰中掷出15或更高，不加任何修正），看看你是否从持续伤害中恢复。

免疫、弱点与抗力

如果一个生物对某种伤害类型具有免疫、弱点或抗力，那么伤害对其产生的影响可能会有所不同。免疫会完全阻止该生物受到任何伤害。弱点会导致该生物受到的伤害增加所列出的数值，而抗力会抵消所列出数值的伤害。因此，如果你使用了一个造成10点火焰伤害的法术，一个对火焰免疫的生物将不会受到伤害，一个具有火焰弱点 5的生物将失去15点生命值，而一个具有火焰抗力 5的生物将失去5点生命值。这种调整适用于每一次伤害，所以如果你对一个具有钝击伤害抗力 5的生物进行了三次造成钝击伤害的打击，它在三次打击中每一次都会少受5点伤害！通常情况下，英雄没有免疫或弱点，尽管法师的抵御能量法术可以提供对某些伤害类型的抗力。

免疫的作用不仅仅体现在伤害上。一个对特定特征免疫的生物完全不受任何具有该特征的事物影响，而一个对某种状态具有免疫的生物无法获得该状态。例如，一个没有心智的生物在其免疫列表中列出了“心灵”。它不仅不会受到心灵伤害，而且具有心灵特征的法术对它根本不起作用！在某些情况下，一个生物可能对攻击或法术的一部分免疫，但对休息不免疫，GM将决定是否属于这种情况。例如，如果你用一把火焰剑击中一个对火焰免疫的怪物，剑本身仍然会造成挥砍伤害，但额外的火焰伤害将不起任何作用。

伤害物品

攻击和伤害物品的规则与生物的规则不同。除非另有说明，否则攻击和法术通常不会对物品造成伤害，陷阱除外。如果你有一面盾牌，如果你使用盾牌格挡反应动作，它可能会受到伤害。

在 Foundry 中应用伤害

在聊天框中的任何伤害投骰下方，你会看到一排按钮，让你能够轻松地将伤害应用到选中的 Token 上。当你选中一个 Token 时，按下“damage”、“double”或“half”按钮将应用相应数值的伤害。还有一个“heal”按钮，它改为恢复相应数值的生命值。如果你的角色正在使用盾牌，并且你想要格挡一次攻击，那么你可以在执行此操作之前开启“block”按钮，以减去相应数值的伤害。

这个省时的辅助功能非常有用，但它确实有局限性。目前，系统不会自动处理伤害抗力、弱点或免疫——如果你的英雄或他们面对的 NPC 拥有此类能力，你可能需要调整所受到的伤害。



原文:

If you make an attack and it hits, or if you successfully cast a spell to harm your foe, you’ll roll dice to determine how much you hurt an enemy. Roll the kind and number of dice indicated by your weapon or spell, and add any numbers listed for that ability (for example, many weapons say to add your Strength to the damage for melee Strikes).

The damage you deal has a type, such as piercing or fire, which can matter since some creatures take more or less damage depending on the type.

Damage you deal decreases the target’s Hit Points by the same amount, so a creature that takes 6 damage loses 6 Hit Points. If penalties to an attack would reduce its damage to 0 or below, you still deal 1 damage. For example, if you threw a dagger and rolled a 1 on the damage roll while you had a –1 penalty to damage rolls, you still deal 1 damage to your target.

Doubling and Halving

You might need to double or halve your damage, depending on the action you used. For instance, many spells deal half damage if your enemy succeeds at its save, full damage if it fails, and double damage if it critically fails. You double or halve the damage after rolling rather than changing the number of dice you roll. Add any bonuses or penalties before you double or halve. Special damage—like the extra damage from a rogue’s sneak attack—is doubled or halved, too. If you halve damage that’s an odd number, round down.

Persistent Damage

Persistent damage, like bleeding or being on fire, hurts you over time. When you gain persistent damage, you don’t take it right away. Instead, you take it at the end of your turn each round. After you take the damage, you attempt a DC 15 flat check (roll a 15 or higher on a d20 without adding anything) to see if you recover from the persistent damage.

Immunities, Weaknesses, and Resistances

Damage might affect a creature differently if it has an immunity, weakness, or resistance to that damage type. Immunity prevents the creature from taking any damage at all. A weakness causes the creature to increase damage they take by the listed amount, and resistance prevents the listed amount of damage. So if you used a spell that deals 10 fire damage, a creature that’s immune to fire would take no damage, a creature with weakness 5 to fire would lose 15 Hit Points, and a creature with resistance 5 to fire would lose 5 Hit Points. This adjustment applies to every instance of damage, so if you made three Strikes that deal bludgeoning damage against a creature with resistance 5 to bludgeoning damage, it would take 5 less damage from each of the three strikes! Usually, heroes don’t have immunities or weaknesses, though the resist energy wizard spell can give resistance to some damage types.

Immunity matters for more than just damage. A creature that’s immune to a certain trait is completely unaffected by anything with that trait, and one with immunity to a condition can’t gain that condition. For instance, a creature without a mind lists “mental” in its immunities. Not only would it take no mental damage, but a spell with the mental trait wouldn’t do anything to it at all! In some cases, a creature is immune to part of an attack or spell but not the rest, and the GM determines whether this is the case. For instance, if you hit a monster that’s immune to fire with a flaming sword, the sword itself would still deal slashing damage, but the extra fire damage wouldn’t do anything.

Damaging Items

The rules for attacking and damaging items differ from the rules for creatures. Attacks and spells don’t normally damage items, except for traps, unless specified otherwise. If you have a shield, it can take damage if you use the Shield Block reaction.

Applying Damage in Foundry

Beneath any damage roll in chat, you'll see a row of buttons that allow you to easily apply damage to selected tokens. While you have a token selected, pressing the "damage", "double", or "half" buttons will apply that much damage. There's also "heal", which instead restores that many hit points. If your character is using a shield, and you would like to block a hit, then you can toggle the "block" button on before doing this to subtract the appropriate amount of damage.

This helpful timesaving feature is widely useful, but it does have limitations. Currently, the system does not automate damage resistances, weaknesses, or immunities- if your heroes or the NPCs they are facing have such abilities, you may need to adjust the damage taken.

Checks.name: 检定 Checks
Checks.text:
【FAIL】

When your hero tries to do something and the outcome is uncertain, you’ll roll a check to see whether you succeed. Pathfinder has many types of checks, from skill checks to attack rolls to saving throws, but they all follow the basic steps explained below: roll the d20, calculate your result, and compare that result to a target number called a difficulty class (DC) to determine whether you succeed or fail.

All checks use the same formula:

d20 + statistic + bonuses and penalties = result

Checks and DCs both come in many forms. When you swing a sword at a monster, you’ll make an attack roll, and its Armor Class is the DC. If you leap across a chasm, you’ll attempt an Athletics skill check with a DC based on how far you’re trying to jump. When trying to remember information about an ancient text, you’ll roll a skill check to Recall Knowledge with a skill and DC determined by the GM.

These are some common types of checks and DCs:

Check

Statistic

Difficulty Class (DC)

Weapon or fist attack

Attack bonus

Armor Class (AC) of the target

Spell attack

Spell attack roll

Armor Class (AC) of the target

Saving throw against a spell

Fortitude, Reflex, or Will

Spell DC of the caster

Perception check

Perception

Stealth DC of a hiding creature or DC set by the GM to find an object in the environment

Stealth check

Stealth Skill

Perception DC of observers

Rolling a Check

Step 1: Roll

Start by rolling your d20! Pay attention to whether you rolled a 20 or a 1 on the die because that does something special when you determine success or failure.

Step 2: Calculate the Result

Add the number you rolled on the d20 to the statistic you’re using (such as your attack bonus or your Stealth), and add any special bonuses and penalties that apply. This total is your result.

Bonuses and Penalties

Sometimes you’ll have a bonus or penalty to add to your roll in addition to the statistic you’re using. For instance, a spell might give you a bonus to an attack roll. Such a bonus might be labelled, like a circumstance bonus, status bonus, or item bonus. You can benefit from only the highest bonus with a given label. For example, if two spells are affecting you, each giving you a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, your total status bonus would still just be +1, not +2. This works the same way for multiple circumstance or item bonuses, too. But if you get a +1 status bonus and a +1 circumstance bonus to an attack roll, you add both! Penalties can have labels too, and they work the same way, except that the number is negative.

Anything without a label is cumulative. For example, the penalty for making multiple attacks in a round and the penalty for attacking at a long range with a ranged weapon don’t have labels, so both would apply to an attack that wasn’t your first of the round and was made at a long range.

Step 3: Determine Success

Often, it’s important to determine not only if you succeed or fail, but also how spectacularly you succeed or fail. Exceptional results can cause you to critically succeed or critically fail.

Critical Success: You exceed the DC by 10 or more.

Success: You meet or exceed the DC.

Failure: Your result is lower than the DC.

Critical Failure: Your result is lower than the DC by 10 or more.

The action you’re using tells you what happens depending on how well you rolled. For instance, if you attacked with a Strike, you’d deal double damage on a critical success, the normal amount of damage on a success, and no damage at all on a failure or critical failure. If an action doesn’t say anything special happens on a critical failure, a critical failure has the same result as a regular failure. For a Strike, a critical failure is no different from a regular failure. Likewise, if an action doesn’t say something special happens on a critical success, it has the same effect as a success.

Rolling a 20 or a 1

Rolling the highest or lowest number on a d20 has some special rules.

If you roll a 20 on the d20, use a result one step better than what you’d normally get based on your roll. This changes a critical failure to a failure, a failure to a success, and a success to a critical success. Usually, this means you critically succeed!

If you roll a 1 on the d20, do the opposite and use a result one step worse. This changes a critical success to a success, a success to a failure, and a failure to a critical failure. Usually, this means you critically fail.

Calculating DCs

For many checks, you’ll compare your result to another creature’s DC, with Strikes, the DC of your attack roll is your target’s Armor Class (AC). Sometimes an enemy’s check uses your DC, like comparing the result of an Intimidation check to Demoralize you to your Will DC. If you need a DC for something that’s normally a statistic, such as a Will DC, just add 10 to the statistic to get the DC. For example, a creature with a Will of +5 has a Will DC of 15.

For other checks, like an Athletics check to Climb a steep cliff, the Game Master sets the DC for you. They have information on how to do so in the @UUID[JournalEntry.S1UnJk4t55aRFaCs.JournalEntryPage.x3B30n5dtJ8XNUnz]{Example DCs} handout.

Special Rules for Checks

Some types of checks follow special rules.

Flat Checks

When something’s based purely on chance, you’ll attempt a flat check. A flat check never includes any modifiers, bonuses, or penalties—you just roll a d20 and compare the result on the die to the DC.

Secret Checks

The secret trait appears on anything that uses secret checks. You use the normal formula for the check, but the GM rolls the d20 in secret. Instead of revealing the result, the GM simply describes the information or effects determined by the check’s result.

Helping Someone

You can @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aid} someone when they attempt a skill check or attack roll to potentially give them a bonus. This requires preparing to help them, usually by spending an action or more on your turn, then using a reaction when they attempt their skill check or attack roll. When you use your reaction, attempt a skill check or attack roll, usually the same type of roll as the one you’re trying to help.

Attacks

Anything that has the attack trait follows some special rules. You can read about @UUID[.rj7hexKclZx0NA3s]{Attacks} here.

Attacks.name: 攻击 Attacks
Attacks.text:
你在进行打击以及其他一些动作时会进行攻击检定。对于大多数攻击检定，你会将你的结果与目标的护甲职业（AC）进行比较。攻击检定主要有三种类型：近战攻击检定、远程攻击检定和法术攻击检定。一些技能也可以用来进行攻击，例如使用运动技能来抓取某人，而不是对其造成伤害。

多重攻击减值

如果你在你的回合中攻击超过一次，你就会受到多重攻击减值。第二次攻击的减值为 -5，第三次及后续攻击的减值为 -10。某些能力或功能，例如武器的灵巧（agile）特征，可以降低你的多重攻击减值。

请务必根据你在该次攻击中使用的武器来计算你的多重攻击减值。如果你先用长剑攻击，然后用短剑（具有灵巧特征）攻击，那么短剑的攻击减值为 -4，即使你的第一次攻击使用的是非灵巧武器。

该减值在每个回合开始时重置。它也仅在你的回合内适用，因此如果你可以进行借机攻击或类似的反应动作，让你在别人的回合进行打击，你就不必记录它。

射程减值

远程和投掷武器对较远目标的准确度较低。武器的射程增量决定了这一间隔。只要你的目标处于列出的射程增量（也称为第一射程增量）之内，你的攻击检定就不会受到减值。超过该距离后，每增加一个增量，你就会受到 -2 的减值。多重攻击减值和射程减值可以同时应用于同一次攻击，这会让你对远处目标的第二次或第三次攻击受到巨大的减值！

光照与黑暗

光照分为三个级别：明亮光照、昏暗光照和黑暗。游戏规则假设你处于明亮光照中，所以大多数时间你不需要担心任何特殊规则。阴影区域或由微弱光源照射的区域处于昏暗光照中。处于昏暗光照中的生物和物体具有 @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽|Concealed} 状态，这意味着任何试图以它们为目标的攻击或其他效果都会失败，除非试图将其作为目标的生物成功通过 DC 5 的纯骰检定（在 d20 掷骰中不加任何加值掷出 5 或更高）。

具有黑暗视觉或低光视觉的生物可以在昏暗光照中看清，并能正常以其中的生物为目标。完全没有光线的区域处于黑暗中。除非寻找它的生物具有黑暗视觉，否则无法看到黑暗中的生物或物体。没有黑暗视觉或其他在黑暗中感知手段的生物在黑暗中处于目盲状态，尽管它可能能够看到黑暗之外的照明区域。当你目盲时，所有地形都是困难地形，并且你在依赖视觉的察觉检定上受到 -4 状态减值。如果你尝试攻击或影响一个因黑暗或其他原因而看不见的目标，除非你成功通过 DC 11 的纯骰检定，否则你会失败。

某些动作要求你选择一个或多个特定目标。如果目标超出射程、你无法确定其位置、它不符合你可以目标的限制，或者某些其他能力阻止其被作为目标，则你无法选择该目标。

某些效果以盟友为目标。这必须是你方的人，通常是另一位英雄，但也可能是你试图保护的旁观者。你不是你自己的盟友。如果不明确，由 GM 决定谁算作盟友或敌人。以自愿生物为目标的能力不会产生任何效果，除非目标允许你影响他们。只有你能决定你的英雄是否自愿，而 GM 决定 NPC 是否自愿。

只有当目标相邻时（即在网格上紧挨着攻击者），近战攻击才能以其为目标。在目标空间的角落对角相邻也算作相邻。某些能力，如战士的突刺（Lunge）专长或变大术（enlarge）法术，可以让某人触及更远的生物。大型生物总是可以触及最远 10 英尺外的生物。

目标选择

知识库：玩家导向

Foundry 虚拟桌面提供了一种简单的方法来指示玩家或 GM 可能正在针对哪个敌人或盟友。你可以通过将鼠标悬停在 Token 上并按下键盘上的 'T' 来快速标记你的目标。要目标多个 Token，玩家可以在按下 T 的同时按住 Shift。这会提供一个小的彩色指示，与分配给玩家的颜色相匹配，从而可以轻松查看谁在针对什么。

寻路者第二版游戏系统还自动执行了许多选项，例如比较 AC 以查看你的攻击是否命中，或者提供诸如偷袭攻击之类的条件加值。只有当你执行动作时已经选择了敌人作为目标，这些自动化功能才会生效。

掩蔽

当你处于可以阻挡武器、保护你免受爆炸影响并让你更难被发现的障碍物后面时，你就处于掩蔽之后。标准掩蔽为你提供 +2 环境加值至 AC、针对区域效果的反射豁免，以及用于隐藏（Hide）、潜行（Sneak）或以其他方式避免被发现的隐秘检定。

生物提供次级掩蔽，这会为 AC 提供 +1 环境加值。具有标准掩蔽的生物可以尝试使用隐秘技能来 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{隐藏|Hide}，但次级掩蔽不足以使用隐秘。

你可能同时对一个生物拥有掩蔽，而对另一个生物没有。只有当你通往目标的路径被部分阻挡时，掩蔽才适用。如果一个生物完全在墙壁或类似物体后面，你通常根本无法以它为目标。由 GM 决定你是否拥有掩蔽，以及它是次级还是标准掩蔽。

如果你和一名盟友位于敌人的相对两侧或角落，你就在夹击该敌人。这会使该生物在面对任何夹击它的攻击时处于措手不及（flat-footed）状态（使其 AC 受到 -2 环境减值）。如果你停止夹击该生物，措手不及状态就会结束。

只有满足以下所有三个条件，你才能进行夹击或帮助盟友进行夹击：

• 没有状态或效果阻止你行动或攻击。

• 你手持近战武器或能够进行徒手攻击。

• 你的距离足够近，可以用攻击触及到敌人。

自动化夹击

寻路者第二版游戏系统包含了夹击的自动化，并在适用情况下适当地启用夹击加值，从而无需你自己进行记录。

理解这种自动化工作原理的一个简单方法是，考虑存在两个“队伍”：链接到玩家拥有的角色的 Token，以及链接到非玩家拥有的角色的 Token。默认情况下，所有玩家角色都在一个队伍中，所有 NPC 都在另一个队伍中，但你可以通过点击 NPC 角色表页眉中的“配置（Configure）”按钮来更改 NPC 的盟友关系。



原文:

You make an attack roll when you Strike and for some other actions. For most attack rolls, you’ll compare your result against your target’s Armor Class (AC). There are three main types of attack rolls: melee attack rolls, ranged attack rolls, and spell attack rolls. Some skills can be used to make attacks, such as Athletics being used to Grapple someone rather than damage them.

Multiple Attack Penalty

If you attack more than once on your turn, you take a multiple attack penalty. This penalty is -5 for your second attack, and -10 for your third and any subsequent attacks. Some abilities or features, such as a weapon's agile trait, reduce your Multiple Attack Penalty.

Always calculate your multiple attack penalty for the weapon you’re using on that attack. If you attack with a longsword, then a shortsword (which has the agile trait), the attack with the shortsword is at –4, even though your first attack was with a weapon that isn’t agile.

The penalty resets every turn. It also applies only during your turn, so you don’t have to keep track of it if you can perform an Attack of Opportunity or a similar reaction that lets you make a Strike on someone else’s turn.

Range Penalty

Ranged and thrown weapons are less accurate against targets farther away. The weapon’s range increment determines this interval. As long as your target is at or within the listed range increment, also called the first range increment, you take no penalty to the attack roll. Beyond that distance, you take a –2 penalty for each additional increment beyond the first. Both the multiple attack penalty and range penalty can apply to the same attack, giving a big penalty to your second or third attack against someone far away!

Light and Darkness

There are three levels of light: bright light, dim light, and darkness. The game’s rules assume you’re in bright light, so most of the time you don’t have to worry about any special rules. Areas in shadow or lit by weak light sources are in dim light. Creatures and objects in dim light have the @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition, meaning any attack or other effect that would target them fails unless the creature trying to target them succeeds at a DC 5 flat check (rolling a 5 or higher on a d20 without adding anything).

A creature with darkvision or low-light vision can see in the dim light and targets creatures in it normally. Areas without any light at all are in darkness. A creature or object in darkness can’t be seen unless the creature looking for it has darkvision. A creature without darkvision or another means of perceiving in darkness is blinded while in darkness, though it might be able to see illuminated areas beyond the darkness. When you’re blinded, all terrain is difficult terrain and you take a –4 status penalty to Perception checks that rely on sight. If you try to attack or affect a target you can’t see due to darkness or for any other reason, you fail unless you succeed at a DC 11 flat check.

Some actions have you select one or more specific targets. You can’t select a target if it’s out of range, if you can’t tell where it is, if it doesn’t match restrictions on who you can target, or if some other ability prevents it from being targeted.

Some effects target an ally. This must be someone on your side, often another hero, but it might be a bystander you’re trying to protect. You aren’t your own ally. If it isn’t clear, the GM decides who counts as an ally or an enemy. An ability that targets a willing creature doesn’t do anything unless the target allows you to affect them. Only you can decide whether your hero is willing, and the GM decides whether an NPC is willing.

Melee attacks can target someone only if they’re adjacent—right next to the attacker on the grid. Being next to them diagonally on the corner of their space is still adjacent. Some abilities, like the Lunge fighter feat or the enlarge spell, let someone reach creatures further away. Large creatures can always reach creatures up to 10 feet away.

Targeting

 Knowledge Base: Player Orientation

Foundry Virtual Tabletop provides a simple approach to indicating which enemy or ally a player or GM may be targeting. You can quickly mark your targets by hovering the mouse over a token and pressing 'T' on your keyboard. To target multiple tokens, a player can hold shift while pressing T. This provides a small colored indicated which matches the color a player has been assigned, and makes it easy to see who's targeting what.

The Pathfinder Second Edition game system also automates a number of options, such as comparing AC to see if your attack should hit, or providing for conditional bonuses such as Sneak Attacks. These automations only function if you have an enemy targeted when you perform your action.

Cover

When you’re behind an obstacle that could block weapons, guard you against explosions, and make you harder to detect, you’re behind cover. Standard cover gives you a +2 circumstance bonus to AC, to Reflex saves against area effects, and to Stealth checks to Hide, Sneak, or otherwise avoid detection.

Creatures give lesser cover, which grants a +1 circumstance bonus to AC. A creature with standard cover can attempt to use the Stealth skill to @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide}, but lesser cover isn’t sufficient for using Stealth.

You might simultaneously have cover against one creature and not another. Cover applies only if your path to the target is partially blocked. If a creature is entirely behind a wall or the like, you typically can’t target it at all. The GM decides whether you have cover and whether it’s lesser or standard.

If you and an ally are on opposite sides or corners of an enemy, you’re flanking that enemy. This gives the creature the flat-footed condition (giving it a –2 circumstance penalty to AC) against attacks from anyone flanking it. If you stop flanking the creature, the flat-footed condition ends.

You can flank or help an ally flank only if you meet all three of the following conditions:

• No condition or effect is preventing you from acting or attacking.

• You’re holding melee weapons or able to make a fist attack.

• You’re close enough to reach the enemy with an attack.

Automated Flanking

The Pathfinder Second Edition game system includes automation of flanking and appropriately enables flanking bonuses for cases where they would apply, removing the need to keep track of it yourself.

A simple way of understanding how this automation works is to consider that there are two "teams", Tokens linked to actors that are owned by players, and tokens whose actors are not. By default, all player characters are on one team and all NPCs are on another, but you can change an NPC's alliance by clicking on the "Configure" button in the header of their actor sheet.

Skills.name: 技能 Skills
Skills.text:
虽然你的角色的能力调整值代表了他们的天赋和潜力，但技能代表了他们在执行各种任务时的训练和经验。你可以使用技能来确定你的角色知道什么，你的角色能跳多远，甚至你的角色能如何影响他人！

技能检定的类型

你可以在 @UUID[.UexG8C5tSZQUdV7z]{技能详述} 日志页面中找到技能列表以及一些可以使用它们的技能动作或活动。

技能动作

每种技能都有你可以使用的特殊动作。其中一些动作任何人都可以尝试，但另一些则要求英雄在该技能中拥有受训（trained）或更高的熟练度等级。

探索活动

一些技能活动具有探索特征。这些通常需要一分钟或更长时间，并且不能在遭遇期间使用。如果你不确定是否有时代使用其中一项活动，请询问你的GM。

秘密检定

如果一个动作具有秘密特征，GM会为你进行检定并告诉你发生了什么，而不会透露掷骰结果。当你掌握的信息不完全时，就会进行秘密检定，例如当你寻找隐藏的生物或物体、试图欺骗某人或回忆某段知识（lore）时。这样，作为玩家的你就不会知道你的角色所不知道的事情。

计算技能调整值

能力调整值

每种技能都使用一个能力调整值，它列在技能旁边——例如，隐秘（Stealth）使用你的敏捷。

熟练度

你的角色卡上的许多数值都包含熟练度加值。如果你的英雄在某项数值上的熟练度等级是受训（trained），则该数值的熟练度加值等于你英雄的等级 + 2。如果是专家（expert），则熟练度加值等于你英雄的等级 + 4。如果你的英雄在该数值上是未受训（untrained），则其熟练度加值为+0。

护甲与技能

如果你穿着护甲，你可能会在涉及力量或敏捷的技能上受到减值。拥有足够的力量可以让你忽略此减值。你会在选择护甲时了解到该减值是否适用。



原文:

While your character's ability modifiers represent their raw talent and potential, skills represent their training and experience at performing various tasks. You can use skills to figure out what your character knows, how far your character can jump, and even how well your character can influence people!

Types of Skill Checks

You can find a list of skills and some of the skill actions or activities that they can be used in in the @UUID[.UexG8C5tSZQUdV7z]{Skill Descriptions} journal page.

Skill Actions

Each skill has special actions you can use. Some of these actions can be attempted by anyone, but others require a hero to have the trained proficiency rank in the skill (or better).

Exploration Activities

Some skill activities have the exploration trait. These usually take a minute or more, and can't be used during an encounter. If you're not sure whether you have the time to use one of these activities, ask your GM.

Secret Checks

If an action has the secret trait, the GM rolls the check for you and tells you what happens without revealing the result of the roll. Secret checks happen when your knowledge is imperfect, like when you’re searching for a hidden creature or object, attempting to deceive someone, or remembering some piece of lore. This way, you as the player don’t know things that your character wouldn’t.

Calculating Skill Modifiers

Ability Modifier

Every skill uses an ability modifier, which is listed next to the skill- for example, Stealth uses your Dexterity.

Proficiency

Many of the statistics on your character sheet will include a proficiency bonus. If your hero’s proficiency rank for a statistic is trained, the proficiency bonus for that statistic equals your hero’s level + 2. If it’s expert, the proficiency bonus equals your hero’s level + 4. If your hero is untrained in that statistic, their proficiency bonus is +0.

Armor and Skills

If you wear armor, you might take a penalty to skills that use your Strength or Dexterity. Having a good Strength lets you ignore this penalty. You'll find out whether the penalty applies when you choose your armor.

Saving Throws.name: 豁免检定 Saving Throws
Saving Throws.text:
一些危险的效果允许你进行豁免检定以减轻其伤害。你会自动进行豁免检定——你不需要使用动作或反应。允许你进行豁免的能力会在其文本中说明。

豁免检定共有三种：强韧（用于抵抗疾病和毒素）、反射（用于躲避可以闪避的效果）以及意志（用于抵抗目标为心灵的效果）。

基础豁免检定

一些造成伤害的法术和其他效果会要求你进行基础豁免检定。你像进行其他豁免一样掷基础豁免检定，但你会根据以下结果来确定你受到了多少伤害。

大成功：你不会受到伤害。

成功：你受到一半所列出的伤害。

失败：你受到全部所列出的伤害。

大失败：你受到双倍所列出的伤害。



原文:

Some dangerous effects let you attempt a saving throw to mitigate their harm. You attempt a saving throw automatically-you don't have to use an action or a reaction. An ability that lets you attempt a save says so in its text.

There are three types of saving throws: Fortitude (to resist diseases and poisons), Reflex (to evade effects that can be dodged), and Will (to resist effects that target the mind).

Basic Saving Throws

Some spells and other effects that deal damage ask you to roll a basic saving throw. You roll a basic saving throw like any other save, but you’ll use the following outcomes to determine how much damage you take.

Critical Success: You take no damage.

Success: You take half the listed damage.

Failure: You take the full listed damage.

Critical Failure: You take double the listed damage.

Menace Under Otari.name: 奥塔里地下的威胁 Menace Under Otari

Hungry Rats.name: 饥饿的巨鼠 Hungry Rats
Hungry Rats.text:
第一场遭遇发生在奥塔里渔场的地下室。巨鼠已经为你布置在房间里了，但目前它们是隐藏的。当它们攻击时你再揭示它们，但现在，先让它们保持隐藏，并向玩家朗读以下内容：

当你走下楼梯，去寻找那只吃掉了所有鱼的野兽时，通往奥塔里渔场地下室的楼梯因年代久远而发出嘎吱声。在房间中央，支撑着上方渔场的石柱之间，摆放着装满咸鱼的木桶。其中两个木桶被砸开了，里面的东西洒了一地。东侧墙壁上有一个大洞，通向黑暗。
就在几个小时前，你和其他几位冒险者聚集在塔米莉·坦德威尔的办公室里，她承诺如果你能终结这个威胁，就给你们每人十枚金币。当你同意帮她完成这个简单的任务时，她非常激动，但当你走下楼梯时，你不禁怀疑这是否比你预想的更具冒险性。

环绕桌子询问每位玩家，他们的英雄在房间里想做的第一件事是什么。当每位玩家描述他们的行动时，允许他们在该区域内移动他们的指示物，但先不要让他们离开房间。

房间南北两侧墙边的架子上堆满了属于渔场的杂项物资。调查房间东侧墙洞的英雄会在房间内侧发现成堆的松散岩石和泥土。看起来像是某种东西从另一侧破墙而入！

在每位玩家都有机会做一件事之后，墙洞里传来一阵令人不安的疾行声——巨鼠出现并准备攻击！向玩家朗读以下内容。

墙洞里传来一阵奇怪的吱吱声。突然，一只狗一般体型的巨大老鼠从黑暗中钻了出来——而且它不是独自一人！巨鼠向你们冲来，巨大的牙齿咔哒作响。

战斗与先攻

 知识库：战斗

开始战斗

你需要为每位玩家准备一只巨鼠。当你准备好后，你应该：

  • 在地图上选中巨鼠指示物，右键点击其中一个，然后点击“切换可见状态（Toggle Visibility State）”来揭示它们。
  • 通过拖拽选择所有巨鼠和英雄的指示物。右键点击其中一个，选择“切换战斗状态（Toggle Combat State）”
  • 一旦它们被添加到战斗追踪器中，你可以通过选择“为NPC掷骰（Roll NPCs）”来快速为所有老鼠掷先攻。
  • 你的玩家可以通过点击战斗追踪器中他们角色旁边的 d20 图标来掷先攻。

弹出侧边栏标签

战斗开始后，你需要留意聊天框以查看掷骰结果。你可以通过在侧边栏双击右键标签图标（交叉的剑）来弹出战斗追踪器，而不必在遭遇追踪器标签和聊天标签之间切换。这将让你把它放在任何你喜欢的地方，而不需要分散注意力。事实上，你可以对任何标签执行此操作，包括聊天记录本身！

在战斗中，每位玩家轮流行动，并遵循关于他们能做什么和不能做什么的特定规则。有关如何处理战斗的逐步说明，请参阅 @UUID[JournalEntry.S1UnJk4t55aRFaCs.JournalEntryPage.ZFjG6Np42VRz5hFu]{遭遇} 日志。

遭遇

@Actor[AYwdybUfm4meGUTJ]{巨鼠 (4)}

点击上方的巨鼠即可查看巨鼠的统计数据。

在它的回合中，每只老鼠都会向不同的英雄移动并攻击。如果一名英雄陷入昏迷，老鼠会移动到最近的下一名英雄并攻击。

攻击

当一个生物使用打击（Strike）动作进行攻击时，首先选择一个在你武器的触及（或射程）范围内的目标。然后，你可以将鼠标悬停在指示物上并按下键盘上的“T”键将其指定为目标。你也可以点击指示物菜单上的目标按钮。如果你作为 GM 需要标记多个目标，你可以选择多个指示物并按 T；而作为玩家，你可以在悬停每个想要目标的指示物时按住 Shift 再按 T。

要使用巨鼠的啃咬（Jaws）进行攻击，请打开该老鼠的角色卡（通过双击巨鼠指示物），并点击啃咬攻击下方攻击栏目中的“打击 (+7)”按钮。这将打开一个对话框，询问是否有任何需要应用的调整值。由于我们没有，只需点击“掷骰 (+7)”。

系统会自动将你的结果与目标的 AC 进行比较。它甚至会考虑到像夹击之类的事情！这种自动化可以为 GM 豁免大量时代，但始终值得检查以确保你没有忘记来自掩蔽之类的调整值。

如果攻击掷骰总值比英雄的护甲职业至少高出 10 点，那就是一次大成功或大失败击中！这些会造成两倍的伤害，并在聊天卡片中以绿色标记。

要掷伤害，请点击聊天侧边栏中的“伤害”按钮（如果攻击是大成功或大失败击中，则点击“大成功或大失败”）。一旦伤害出现在聊天记录中，你可以选择受影响的指示物，并点击伤害总额下方的相应按钮来应用相应的伤害值。

经验值

击败巨鼠后，奖励每位英雄 80 XP。

战斗后

一旦一方被击败或逃跑，你就不再需要追踪动作，英雄们也不再需要按顺序行动。相反，环顾桌子询问玩家英雄们接下来想做什么。如果英雄们回去找塔米莉谈话，她得知老鼠死后松了一口气，但她确信老鼠不可能造成下面所有的破坏。如果英雄们想要获得奖励，他们必须进一步探索。当玩家决定探索这个房间之外的地方时，请回合至 @UUID[.VLztUZ1H5YEYPcx9]{02: 深入黑暗}



原文:

The first encounter happens in the basement of the Otari Fishery. The giant rats are already placed in the room for you, but currently, they're hidden. You'll reveal them when they attack, but for now, leave them hidden and read the following to the players:

The stairs leading into the basement of the Otari Fishery creak with age as you make your way downstairs to find the beast that has been eating all the fish. In the center of the room, between stone pillars holding up the fishery overhead, are barrels filled with salted fish. Two of these barrels have been smashed open, spilling their contents on the floor. In the east wall is a large hole, opening into darkness.
Just a few hours ago, you gathered with a few other adventurers in the office of Tamily Tanderveil, where she offered you ten gold pieces each if you could put an end to this menace. She was thrilled when you agreed to help her with this simple task, but as you make your way downstairs, you can't help but wonder if this might be a lot more adventure than you bargained for.

Go around the table and ask each player the first thing they want their hero to do in the room. As each player describes their action, allow them to move their token around this area, but don't let them leave the room just yet.

The shelves along the walls on the north and south sides of the room are piled high with general supplies that belong to the fishery. Heroes who investigate the hole in the wall on the east side of the room find piles of loose rock and dirt on the inside of the room. It looks like something has broken open the wall from the other side!

After each player has had a chance to do one thing, an ominous skittering noise comes from the hole in the wall- giant rats emerge to attack! Read the following to the players.

A strange chittering comes from the hole in the wall. Suddenly, a massive rat the size of a dog emerges from the darkness—and it isn't alone! The giant rats rush toward you, their huge teeth snapping.

Combat and Initiative

 Knowledge Base: Combat

Starting a Combat

You'll need one giant rat for each player. When you're ready, you should:

  • Reveal the rat tokens on the map by selecting them, right-clicking on one, and clicking "Toggle Visibility State".
  • Select the tokens for the rats and the heroes by drag-selecting them all. Right-click one of them, and choose "Toggle Combat State"
  • Once they're added to the combat tracker, you can quickly roll initiative for all of the rats by choosing "Roll NPCs."
  • Your players may roll initiative by clicking the d20 icon next to their character in the combat tracker.

Popping Out a Sidebar Tab

Once combat's begun, you'll need to keep an eye on the chat to see the results of rolls. Instead of needing to tab between the encounter tracker tab and the chat tab, you can pop the combat tracker out by double right-clicking on the tab's icon (the crossed swords) on your sidebar. This will let you position it wherever you'd like without needing to split attention. In fact, you can do this to any tab, including the chat log itself!

In combat, each player takes turns and follows specific rules about what they can and can't do. See the @UUID[JournalEntry.S1UnJk4t55aRFaCs.JournalEntryPage.ZFjG6Np42VRz5hFu]{Encounters} journal for step-by-step instructions on how to handle combat.

Encounter

@Actor[AYwdybUfm4meGUTJ]{Giant Rats (4)}

The Giant rats' statistics can be viewed by clicking Giant Rats above.

On its turn, each rat moves toward a different hero and attacks. If a hero falls unconscious, the rat moves to the next nearest and attacks.

Attacks

When a creature uses the Strike action to make an attack, first pick a target within the reach (or range) of your weapon. Then, you can hover over a token and press 'T' on your keyboard to designate it as a target. You can also click the targeting button on the token menu. If you need to mark more than one target as a GM, you can select multiple tokens and press T, while as a player you can hold shift before pressing T while hovering each token you wish to target.

To attack using the Jaws of a Giant Rat, open the character sheet for the rat (by double-clicking on the Giant Rat Token) and click the "Strike (+7)" button in the Attacks section of the sheet listed below the Jaws attack. This will open a dialog box asking if there are any modifiers that need to be applied. Since we have none, simply click "Roll (+7)".

The system will compare your result to the target's AC automatically. It even takes into account things like flanking! This automation can save a lot of time for the GM, but it's always worth checking to make sure you didn't forget a modifier from something like cover.

If the total attack roll is at least 10 more than the hero's Armor class, it's a critical hit! These deal twice as much damage, and are marked in green in the chat card.

To roll damage, click the "Damage" button in the chat sidebar (or "Critical" if the attack was a critical hit). Once the damage appears in the chat log, you can select the token affected and click the appropriate button beneath the damage total to apply the appropriate damage value. 

Experience Points

For defeating the giant rats, give each hero 80 XP.

After Combat

Once one side is defeated or flees, you don't need to track actions anymore and heroes no longer need to act in order. Instead, go around the table and ask the players what the heroes would like to do next. If the heroes return to talk to Tamily, she’s relieved to learn that the rats are dead, but she is certain that rats couldn't have caused all of the destruction below. The heroes will have to explore further if they want to earn their reward. When the players decide to explore beyond this room, turn to @UUID[.VLztUZ1H5YEYPcx9]{02: Drop into Darkness}

Drop into Darkness.name: 深入黑暗 Drop into Darkness
Drop into Darkness.text:
在对付完老鼠之后，英雄们可以自由地探索储藏室东墙上的洞。它足够大，能让人轻松地爬过去。当第一个英雄进入区域之后，大声朗读以下内容。

从洞口挤过去，你发现自己置身于一个洞穴中，它似乎在奥塔里的街道下方无尽地延伸。谁知道下面潜伏着什么威胁呢？前方，通道尽头是一处陡峭切入黑暗的悬崖。

闯入储藏室的怪物利用这条通道穿透了墙壁，但它们来自奥塔里地下庞大洞穴群的更深处。

技能检定

为了继续他们的冒险，玩家必须想办法爬下一段简短而湿滑的悬崖。英雄们不需要使用战斗能力，而是每人都需要尝试一次@UUID[JournalEntry.OoPjlnYYGLn5KPZy.JournalEntryPage.DyVmklA6nwuY8sgU]{技能 检定}来查看成功或失败。此检定需要运动技能，该技能用于攀爬墙壁、绳索和树木。其他技能及其用途的列表可以在@UUID[JournalEntry.OoPjlnYYGLn5KPZy.JournalEntryPage.UexG8C5tSZQUdV7z]{此处}找到。

悬崖只有10英尺高，但表面因潮湿而湿滑。安全地@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{攀爬}需要一次@Check[type:athletics|dc:15]{运动技能 检定}。

技能与检定

@UUID[JournalEntry.OoPjlnYYGLn5KPZy.JournalEntryPage.nQgj1rvfQhLtlspj]{技能} @UUID[JournalEntry.OoPjlnYYGLn5KPZy.JournalEntryPage.DyVmklA6nwuY8sgU]{检定}

你可能已经注意到，上面的技能 检定实际上是一个按钮！在选中指示物的情况下点击它，将使用该生物的数值来结算检定——在这种情况下，是DC为15的运动技能 检定。生成的聊天卡片将自动计入你的修正值并给出你的成功程度。

当然，理想情况下，你会希望你的玩家能够进行该检定。虽然你仍然可以要求进行运动技能 检定并亲自将结果与DC进行比较，但另一种选择是按下检定按钮上的小气泡图标。这会将按钮发送到聊天框，而不会分享周围任何仅限GM查看的文本，让你的玩家可以轻松进行技能检定而无剧透风险！

绳索与其他形式的援助

玩家可能会决定使用绳索来帮助他们攀爬悬崖。他们可以轻易地将绳索系在附近众多坚固的石笋之一上。一旦完成，攀爬的运动检定仅需@Check[type:athletics|dc:10]{运动技能 检定}；角色只有在骰出1时才会大失败，如果总值达到20或更高，则获得大成功或大失败 成功。

英雄们也可以尝试互相帮助。帮助他人攀爬的角色必须尝试自己的运动检定来进行协助。如果成功，攀爬的角色在其检定中获得+1环境加值（如果协助的角色获得大成功，则为+2）。提供协助的英雄仍必须尝试自己的运动检定来攀爬。

投骰结果结果

大成功
（骰出20或总值达到25或更多）

角色爬上或爬下悬崖，安全抵达目的地。

成功
（总值达到15或更多）

角色向上或向下攀爬5英尺。他们必须再次进行检定才能完成这段路程。

失败
（总值小于15）

角色完全没有进展。他们留在墙上的原处。

大失败
（骰出1或总值达到5或更少）

角色摔落到地面。如果他们在顶部，则因坠落受到5点伤害。如果他们在半路，则因坠落仅受到2点伤害。如果角色正尝试向上爬且这是他们的第一次检定，他们只是倒地且不受到伤害。

经验值

一旦英雄们全部爬下悬崖，奖励每人10 XP以克服此挑战。

探索地下城

一旦英雄们爬下悬崖，他们就可以继续前往下一个区域。这条隧道里没有什么有趣的东西，但任何观察的人都能在尘土和污垢中发现一条踪迹，这清楚地表明最近有生物走过这条路。然而，水分和时代掩盖了诸如脚印之类的任何细节。洞穴下部的蘑菇特别苦，但可以食用。

从这一点开始，角色可以按照自己的节奏自由探索地下城。他们可以继续推进，也可以撤退回上方的城镇休息并获取新补给。

一旦英雄们探索了一个区域，该区域就会保持英雄们上次在那里的时代离开时的样子。任何存活的怪物都会恢复失去的生命值，但那些被杀死的怪物在英雄们返回时仍然保持死亡状态。

光照

从这个区域开始，除非另有说明，否则房间完全是黑暗的。因其族裔或传承而拥有黑暗视觉的角色可以正常视物。其他人需要提供自己的光源以便视物。只要有一名角色拿着火把，大多数房间都足够小，火把可以照亮整个区域。

动态光照

 知识库：光照 @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.WBmvzNDfpwka3qT4]{光亮术} @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.8Jdw4yAzWYylGePS]{火把}

Foundry VTT支持动态光照，这意味着指示物在移动时可以随身携带光源。

如果你的玩家之一拥有火把或光亮术法术，他们可能想在这里使用这些工具。不过，没有必要直接编辑他们指示物的光照设置——如果他们将光亮术效果从他们的法术卡拖到他们的指示物上，他们将立即开始发出光源，为玩家及其盟友照亮场景。同样，如果角色正在使用火把提供光照，他们可以在手中装备火把，并在其角色卡的动作选项卡上通过复选框将其点亮。 



原文:

After dealing with the rats, the heroes are free to explore the hole in the east wall of the storeroom. It is big enough for a human to crawl through with ease. Once the first hero enters the area beyond, read the following aloud.

Squeezing through the hole, you find yourself in a cavern that seems to stretch endlessly beneath the streets of Otari. Who knows what menace could be lurking down here? Up ahead, the passageway ends in a cliff that plunges sharply into the darkness.

The monsters that broke into the storeroom used this passageway to break through the wall, but they came from much deeper parts of the vast series of caverns beneath Otari.

Skill Checks

To continue on their adventure, the players must find a way to climb down a short, slippery cliff. Instead of using combat abilities, the heroes each need to attempt a @UUID[JournalEntry.OoPjlnYYGLn5KPZy.JournalEntryPage.DyVmklA6nwuY8sgU]{Skill Check} to see if they succeed or fail. This check requires the Athletics skill, which is used for climbing up and down walls, ropes, and trees. A list of the other skills and their uses can be found @UUID[JournalEntry.OoPjlnYYGLn5KPZy.JournalEntryPage.UexG8C5tSZQUdV7z]{here}.

The cliff is only 10 feet tall, but the surface is slick with moisture. @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climbing} safely requires a @Check[type:athletics|dc:15]{Athletics Skill Check}.

Skills and Checks

@UUID[JournalEntry.OoPjlnYYGLn5KPZy.JournalEntryPage.nQgj1rvfQhLtlspj]{Skills} @UUID[JournalEntry.OoPjlnYYGLn5KPZy.JournalEntryPage.DyVmklA6nwuY8sgU]{Checks}

You might have noticed that the skill check above is actually a button! Clicking it while you have a token selected will use that creature's statistics to resolve the check- in this case, an Athletics skill check with a DC of 15. The resulting chat card will take into account your modifiers and give you your degree of success, automatically.

Of course, ideally, you'd want your players to be able to roll that check. While you can still ask for an athletics skill check and compare the result to the DC yourself, another option is to press the little speech bubble icon on the check button. This will post the button to chat without sharing any of the GM-only text that surrounds it, allowing your players to easily roll their skill checks without risk of spoilers!

Rope and Other Forms of Aid

The players might decide to use rope to help them scale the cliff. They can easily tie a rope to one of numerous sturdy stalagmites nearby. Once this is done, the Athletics check to climb up or down is only a @Check[type:athletics|dc:10]{Athletics Skill Check}; a character critically fails only by rolling a 1 on the die, and they score a critical success if the total is 20 or higher.

The heroes might also try and help each other get up and down. A character helping someone else climb must attempt their own Athletics check to assist. If they succeed, the character climbing gets a +1 circumstance bonus to their check (+2 if the assisting character critically succeeds). A hero providing assistance must still roll their own Athletics check to climb up or down themself.

Roll ResultOutcome

Critical Success
(roll of 20 or total of 25 or more)

The character climbs up or down the cliff, reaching their destination safely.

Success
(total of 15 or more)

The character climbs 5 feet up or down the wall. They must roll another check to complete the journey.

Failure
(total of less than 15)

The character makes no progress at all. They stay where they are at on the wall.

Critical Failure
(roll of 1 or total of 5 or less)

The character falls to the ground. If they were at the top, they take 5 damage from the fall. If they were halfway up, they take only 2 damage from the fall. If the character was trying to climb up and this was their first check, they simply fall prone and take no damage.

Experience Points

Once the heroes have all climbed down the cliff, award them each 10 XP for overcoming this challenge.

Exploring the Dungeon

Once the heroes climb down the cliff, they can continue onward to the next area. There is little of interest in this tunnel, but anyone who looks can find a trail in the dust and grime, making it clear that creatures have come this way in the recent past. Moisture and time have obscured any details such as footprints, however. The mushrooms in the lower part of the chamber are particularly bitter, but edible.

From this point onward, the characters are free to explore the dungeon at their own pace. They can continue to press forward, or they can retreat back to the town above to rest and get new supplies.

Once the heroes have explored an area, that area remains as the heroes left it the last time they were there. Any monsters left alive recover lost Hit Points, but those that were killed remain dead upon the heroes’ return.

Light

From this area onward, the chambers are completely dark unless their descriptions state otherwise. Characters who have darkvision from their ancestry or heritage can see normally. Others need to provide their own source of light so that they can see. As long as one character is holding a torch, most of the rooms are small enough that the torch illuminates the entire area.

Dynamic Lighting

 Knowledge Base: Lighting @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.WBmvzNDfpwka3qT4]{Light} @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.8Jdw4yAzWYylGePS]{Torch}

Foundry VTT supports dynamic lighting, which means that tokens can carry light sources around with them as they move.

If one of your players has access to a torch, or the light spell, they might want to make use of those tools here. There's no need to edit their token's light settings directly, however- if they drag the Light effect from their spell card to their token, they will immediately begin emanating a light source which will illuminate the scene for the player and their allies. Similarly, if a character is using a torch to provide light, they can equip the torch in a hand and light it with the checkbox on the actions tab of their character sheet.

The Spider’s Web.name: 蛛网 The Spider’s Web
The Spider’s Web.text:
这个房间里有厚厚的蛛网和一只巨大的蜘蛛。巨蜘蛛指示物已经为你放置在场景中了，但就像之前遭遇中的老鼠一样，它对玩家是隐藏的。当英雄们进入这个区域时，大声朗读以下内容。

隧道继续向地下深处延伸，最终通向一个大洞穴。几片发光的蓝色真菌附着在天花板上，提供了昏暗光照。你只能勉强辨认出横跨这个洞穴地面和墙壁的巨大蛛网，它们像闪闪发光的帘幕一样在钟乳石之间延伸。

这场战斗使用与第一次对抗老鼠相同的规则，但它也包含了处理蛛网时的技能检定，并包括一种新型的@UUID[JournalEntry.OoPjlnYYGLn5KPZy.JournalEntryPage.DyVmklA6nwuY8sgU]{检定}——豁免检定——来抵抗蜘蛛带毒的咬伤！

这个洞穴是一只非常大的蜘蛛的家，它正等待着伏击任何在它的网中游荡的生物。这些网还没有粘到能让任何接触到它们的人无法移动，但它们确实会减慢角色的速度。每一个有蛛网的方格都是困难地形——一种特别难以移动通过的地形。移动进入一个困难地形方格需要额外的5英尺移动距离，且生物不能快步（Step）进入困难地形方格。蜘蛛不受其蛛网的影响，可以在洞穴中正常移动。

当玩家进入洞穴时，蜘蛛位于房间东北角的巢穴中。直到有人触碰到它的蛛网，它才会现身发起攻击。任何试图在不触碰蛛网的情况下穿过房间的人必须尝试一次@Check[type:acrobatics|dc:15]{特技 技能 检定}，以在岩石和狭窄的岩架上小心地保持平衡。如果有人检定失败，蜘蛛就会感官到他们在房间里，并现身发起攻击。

与蜘蛛的战斗进行起来非常像与老鼠的战斗。一旦有人触碰到蛛网或在穿过房间进行平衡的特技检定中失败，就要求所有人投掷先攻——通常使用察觉，或者对于当时正在躲藏的人使用隐秘。蜘蛛投掷察觉作为其先攻。

在你获得所有人的先攻结果后，由投出最高先攻结果的角色开始第一轮战斗。每个角色在他们的回合到来时可以使用3个动作，当每个人都完成了一个回合后，从头再次开始。

英雄们可以通过小心地绕过蛛网来避免这场战斗。他们也可能从蜘蛛身边逃跑。蜘蛛拒绝离开这个区域，如果所有英雄都逃跑了，它会撤退到东北部布满蛛网的巢穴。

蜘蛛战斗

@Actor[6NdqvKIlxo4cGhf8]{巨蜘蛛}

豁免检定

每当蜘蛛成功用它的毒牙攻击一名角色时，它会在攻击中注入毒素。每当一名角色受到毒素影响时，他们必须尝试一种称为豁免检定的特殊检定来抵抗其效果。豁免检定有三种类型：强韧豁免通常用于抵抗毒素或疾病，反射豁免用于躲避坠落的碎片或避开来自法术的致命射线，而意志 豁免通常用于抵抗迷惑心灵的法术和魔法。

任何被蜘蛛咬伤的人必须立即尝试一次强韧豁免检定，方法是点击其角色卡豁免部分“强韧”下的 d20 图标。如果结果等于或大于 16，他们就抵抗了毒素，不会遭受不良效果。如果结果小于 16，毒素就会发作！毒素效果的细节包含在蜘蛛的数据表中。

远程打击

巨蜘蛛还拥有一种特殊的远程打击，让它能投掷蛛网来困住附近的生物。与近战打击不同，巨蜘蛛不需要与英雄相邻就能用远程打击目标他们——它可以目标房间内任何地方的英雄。除此之外，远程打击的工作方式与近战打击完全一样。通过将鼠标悬停在指示物上并按 T 来选择一个目标，然后点击巨蜘蛛蛛网打击（Web Strike）上的“Strike+ 7”按钮，然后将总值与目标英雄的护甲 职业进行比较，看看是否命中。

虽然远程打击通常像近战打击一样造成伤害，但这种蛛网打击是特殊的。如果攻击投骰成功，目标不会受到任何伤害。相反，目标会被@Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}，并且在成功使用脱逃基础动作之前无法移出其方格。你可以通过将禁足效果从本日志直接拖动到受影响的指示物上来应用它。目标可以尝试使用特技技能或运动技能或拳头攻击投骰来进行脱逃检定，DC 为 17。每次尝试脱逃都是一个单动作。

如果脱逃检定的总结果为 17 或更大，目标将从蛛网中挣脱并可以自由移动。你可以通过右键点击受影响的指示物，点击右侧的“分配状态效果”按钮，然后右键点击禁足效果来移除禁足效果。被困住的英雄仍然可以攻击、施放法术以及进行其他正常行动，但他们不能从地图上当前的空间移动。

经验值

有时挑战会为英雄提供多种克服它们的方法。无论英雄如何克服挑战，他们都会因此获得 XP——但只有在他们第 1 次克服挑战时！如果英雄避开了与蜘蛛的战斗，而你因此奖励了他们 XP，那么如果他们后来又回去与蜘蛛战斗，他们就不会获得更多 XP。

英雄们第 1 次通过蜘蛛挑战时，无论是通过击败还是避开它，都奖励他们每人 40 XP。

搜索蜘蛛巢穴

@Actor[PziNyZC7L7e9SsGr]{蜘蛛巢穴}

一旦英雄们击败了蜘蛛，玩家可能会想到检定蜘蛛的巢穴，看看蛛网中是否隐藏了任何有价值的东西。要求任何探索该区域的人尝试一次@Check[type:perception|dc:15]{察觉 检定}。如果他们成功，他们会发现一捆包裹着的骨头和干皮，看起来像是某种小型爬行生物（实际上，它是一个狗头人，是负责闯入渔场地下室的生物之一）。

包裹中还包含一些有价值的物品——一瓶治疗药水和一把剑柄上镶嵌着小祖母绿的短剑。虽然这把剑不是魔法武器，但精湛的工艺和珍贵的宝石使其在出售时价值 5 gp。

战利品角色

寻路者第二版系统包含收录了 Paizo 在 OGL 许可下发布的每件物品的汇编，这使得向玩家发放战利品变得轻而易举。不过，为了为你节省更多时代，我们在场景中放置了一种特殊类型的角色，称为“战利品角色”，其中的物品已准备好供他们拾取。如果你的玩家找到了狗头人的遗骸，你只需在地图上显现该角色，他们就能打开其物品栏并查看（并领取！）其中的物品。

未来的几个房间也包含像这样的战利品角色，所以请留意这些箱子！

特殊物品

战利品表中的一件物品——@Item[LKjaRu3wDgEBpb9C]{治疗药水}——是一种魔法消耗品。本冒险中的少数特殊物品可能具有独特的艺术图，你可以通过在物品标签页中右键点击它并点击“查看物品艺术图”，然后点击“展示给玩家”来与你的玩家分享。

如果你愿意，可以使用神秘化功能来隐藏玩家尚未鉴定的物品名称和描述。为此，在你显现战利品表之前，点击其物品栏中相应物品上的问号图标。

避开威胁

如果英雄们在这个房间里移动时非常小心，他们可能会完全避开与蜘蛛的战斗。他们也可能从蜘蛛身边逃跑，在不击败它的情况下通过这个区域的遭遇。在任何一种情况下，每当英雄们穿过这个洞穴时，蜘蛛仍然是一个威胁。

在某些冒险中，如果玩家花费太长时间或休息太频繁，情况会发生变化，但无论玩家在探索这个地下城时花费多长时间，本冒险及其遭遇都保持不变。英雄们击败的任何生物都保持死亡或被摧毁状态，而他们避开的任何生物都留在原地——如果英雄们稍后再次经过该区域，可能会构成危险！



原文:
