This room contains thick webs and an enormous spider. The Giant Spider token has already been placed on the scene for you, but like the rats in the previous encounter is hidden from player view. When the heroes enter this area, read the following aloud.

The tunnel continues deeper underground, eventually opening into a large chamber. Patches of glowing blue fungus cling to the ceiling and provide dim light. You can just barely make out vast strands of webbing across the floor and walls of this cavern, stretching between stalactites like shimmering curtains.

This fight uses the same rules as the first fight against the rats, but it also incorporates skill checks when dealing with webs and includes a new kind of @UUID[JournalEntry.OoPjlnYYGLn5KPZy.JournalEntryPage.DyVmklA6nwuY8sgU]{Check}—a saving throw—to resist the spider’s poisonous bite!

This chamber is home to a very big spider, waiting to ambush anything that wanders through its web. The webs aren’t sticky enough to make anyone who touches them unable to move, but they do slow characters down. Each square that has webbing in it is difficult terrain—terrain that’s particularly hard to move through. Moving into a square of difficult terrain costs an extra 5 feet of movement, and a creature can’t Step into a square of difficult terrain. The spider isn’t affected by its webs and can move normally throughout the chamber.

When the players enter the chamber, the spider is in its lair in the northeast corner of the room. It does not emerge to attack until someone touches one of its webs. Anyone trying to cross through the room without touching the webs must attempt an @Check[type:acrobatics|dc:15]{Acrobatics Skill Check} to carefully balance on rocks and narrow ledges. If anyone fails the check, the spider senses them in the room and emerges to attack.

The fight with the spider plays out very much like the combat with the rats. As soon as someone touches one of the webs or fails an Acrobatics check to balance while crossing the room, call for everyone to roll for initiative—usually using Perception, or Stealth for anyone who was hiding at the time. The spider rolls Perception for its initiative.

After you have everyone’s initiative results, start the first round of combat with the character who rolled the highest initiative result. Each character gets to use 3 actions when their turn comes up, and when everyone has had a turn, start over again at the beginning.

The heroes might avoid this fight by carefully moving around the webs. They might also flee from the spider. The spider refuses to leave this area, retreating to its webbed den in the northeast if all the heroes flee.

Spider Fight

@Actor[6NdqvKIlxo4cGhf8]{Giant Spider}

Saving Throws

Whenever the spider manages to successfully attack a character with its fangs, it injects poison as part of the attack. Whenever a character is subjected to poison, they must attempt a special check called a saving throw to resist its effects. There are three types of saving throw: a Fortitude save is typically for resisting poison or disease, a Reflex save is for dodging away from falling debris or avoiding a deadly beam from a spell, and a Will save is usually for resisting spells and magic that befuddle the mind.

Anyone who is bitten by the spider must immediately attempt a Fortitude saving throw by clicking the d20 icon under "Fortitude" in the saves section of their character sheet. If the result is equal to or greater than 16, they resist the poison and suffer no ill effect. If the result is less than 16, the poison takes hold! The details of the poison's effects are included in the spider's stat block.

Ranged Strikes

The giant spider also has a special ranged Strike that lets it throw webbing to trap a nearby creature. Unlike for a melee Strike, the giant spider doesn’t have to be adjacent to a hero to target them with a ranged Strike—it can target a hero anywhere in the room. Otherwise, a ranged Strike works just like a melee Strike. Choose a target by hovering over the token and pressing T, then click the "Strike+ 7" button on the giant spider’s Web Strike, and then compare the total to the Armor Class of the target hero to see if it hits.

While ranged Strikes normally deal damage just like melee Strikes, this web Strike is special. If the attack roll is a success, the target doesn’t take any damage. Instead, the target is @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} and can’t move out of their square until they successfully use the Escape basic action. You can apply the Immobilized effect by dragging it from this journal directly to the affected token. The target can attempt a check to Escape using the Acrobatics skill or Athletics skill, or a fists attack roll, and the DC is 17. Each attempt to Escape is a single action.

If the total result of the check to Escape is 17 or greater, the target breaks free from the webs and can move freely. You can remove the immobilization effect by right-clicking on the affected token, clicking the "Assign Status Effects" button on the right, and then right-clicking the immobilized effect.  A stuck hero can still attack, cast spells, and otherwise act normally, but they can’t move from their current space on the map.

Experience Points

Sometimes challenges offer multiple ways for the heroes to overcome them. No matter how the heroes overcome a challenge, they earn XP for doing so- but only the first time they overcome it! If the heroes avoid the fight with the spider and you award them XP for doing so, they don't get more XP if they later go back and fight the spider.

The first time the heroes get past the spider, whether by defeating or avoiding it, award them each 40 XP.

Searching the Spider's Lair

@Actor[PziNyZC7L7e9SsGr]{Spider's Lair}

Once the heroes defeat the spider, the players might think to check the spider's lair to see if there is anything of value hidden in the webs. Ask anyone who explores the area to attempt a @Check[type:perception|dc:15]{Perception Check}. If they succeed, they spot a wrapped up bundle of bones and dried skin that looks like it was some sort of small, reptilian creature (in fact, it's a kobold, one of the creatures responsible for breaking into the basement of the fishery).

The bundle also contains a few items of value- a healing potion and a shortsword that has a small emerald in the pommel. While the sword isn't magical, the fine craftsmanship and precious gem make it worth 5 gp if sold.

Loot Actors

The Pathfinder Second Edition system includes compendiums containing every item released by Paizo under the OGL license, which makes handing out loot to players a breeze. To save you even more time, though, we've placed a special type of actor called a "loot actor" on the scene with the items ready for them to pick up. If your players locate the kobold's remains, you can simply reveal the actor on the map, and they'll be able to open its inventory and see (and claim!) the items within.

Several future rooms include loot actors like this one, so keep an eye out for these boxes!

Special Items

One of the items inside the loot sheet- the @Item[LKjaRu3wDgEBpb9C]{Healing Potion}- is a magical consumable. A small number of special items in this adventure may have unique artwork, which you can share with your players by right-clicking on it in the items tab and clicking "view item artwork" followed by "show to players".

If you'd like, you can use the mystification feature to hide the names and descriptions of items that the players have yet to identify. To do this, before you reveal the loot sheet, click on the question mark icon on the corresponding item within its inventory.

Avoiding the Threat

If the heroes are very careful moving around this room, they might avoid the fight with the spider entirely. They might also flee from the spider, moving past the encounter in this area without defeating it. In either case, the spider remains a threat every time the heroes pass through this chamber.

In some adventures, the situation changes if the players take too long or rest too often, but this adventure and its encounter remain the same no matter how long the players take in exploring this dungeon. Any creatures the heroes defeat remain dead or destroyed, and any creatures they avoid remain in the same place—potentially posing a danger if the heroes pass through that area again later!

The Barricade.name: 路障 The Barricade
The Barricade.text:
这个路口为英雄们提供了一个选择前进方向的机会，其中包含一个技能挑战，这可能会影响他们在地下城深处的遭遇。

在蛛网密布的洞穴之后，通往奥塔里街道下方的通道看起来大多是自然形成的，但有人或某种生物曾努力开凿洞穴并平整地面，使通道易于通行。一个由旧木板和部分木桶组成的粗糙路障挡住了一个侧面隧道的入口，而主通道则继续延伸到阴影中。

如果有英雄检查路障，请让他们尝试一次@Check[type:perception|dc:15]{察觉 检定}。在成功时，他们会听到从路障后面的某个地方传来的微弱咔哒声。该区域完全没有照明，但持有火把或拥有黑暗视觉的角色可以辨认出隧道通向前方一个更大的房间，中间有一个巨大的矩形物体。

英雄们有两种拆除路障的方法。他们可以用武器轻易摧毁屏障，但这会产生巨大的噪音，并提醒区域 5 中的怪物英雄们的到来。

他们也可以尝试通过掷骰进行@Check[type:crafting|dc:15]{手艺 技能 检定}或@Check[type:thievery|dc:15]{贼活 技能 检定}来悄悄拆除路障。无论成功还是失败，他们的努力都会移除路障，但如果失败，他们发出的噪音足以提醒@UUID[.mJ3pVc1aJi98duaA]{区域 05}中的敌人。如果成功，他们就能避免惊动怪物。

如果你正在使用增强版地图，可能会有额外的工具可以用来让这一时刻尽可能顺利。请务必阅读下面的信息框以了解更多信息！

门

 知识库：墙

在这里，玩家面临一个障碍，它阻碍了向北进一步进入隧道的移动和视线。你可能会注意到地图上路障上方有一个门图标——那是因为这个路障就是一扇门！

Foundry中的门

在Foundry VTT中，门只是一种墙壁类型，玩家或GM点击图标即可打开。它们可以具有与其他类型墙壁相同的特征——它们可以阻挡光线、声音、视线和移动的任何组合，或者都不阻挡。门还有一些普通墙壁没有的额外选项——你可以锁定门，让玩家无法打开，甚至可以向玩家隐藏其图标，制作只有GM才能打开的“秘密”门。要亲自查看这些设置，你可以导航到工具栏上的墙壁层（神庙图标），然后双击任何墙壁节点。

清理路障

在这种情况下，这面墙已经为你预先配置好了。它是“秘密”的，这意味着它只能由GM看到或打开，并且它同时阻挡移动和视线。玩家需要成功通过一次技能 检定来清理路障，届时你只需将其移除即可让他们通过。在原始地图上，你只需点击门图标即可完成此操作。

如果你正在使用我们的增强版地图，你还可以选择更进一步。我们在场景中包含了一个图块，可以在拆除路障时进行更换。我们甚至提供了一个宏来为你完成这项工作！运行时，它会播放一段声音效果，具体取决于你的队伍是吵闹地还是安静地拆除了路障。然后，在短暂的延迟后，它会更换图块并在同一时代打开门。

要使用该宏，你只需点击这里 @Macro[saQTdI63wy22v5yk]{区域 04 - Barricade}，并在背景播放声音时开始叙述你的玩家如何绕过障碍。

本冒险中的其他门

在@UUID[.UCEZLyerntYnmzgX]{区域 07}有一扇锁着的门，在@UUID[.2KRdW68qNXeJ6JpN]{区域 12}和@UUID[.CMjhAWaRWlbFVoF0]{区域 15}也有与路障类似的障碍，这两处也都提供了宏。

经验值

如果英雄们悄悄拆除了路障，奖励每人10 XP。



原文:

This intersection presents the heroes with a choice of which direction to go, and it includes a skill challenge that can affect their encounters further within the dungeon.

After the web-infested cave, the passageway leading deeper underneath the streets of Otari appears to be mostly natural, but someone, or something, has worked to open the cavern and level out the floor, making the passage easily traveled. A crude barricade made from old wooden planks and part of a barrel blocks the entrance to a side tunnel, while the main passage continues off into the gloom.

If any hero examines the barricade, ask them to attempt a @Check[type:perception|dc:15]{Perception Check}. On a success, they hear a faint clattering noise coming from somewhere beyond the barricade. The area is totally unlit, but characters with a torch or darkvision can tell that the tunnel opens up into a larger room ahead, with a large rectangular object in the middle.

There are two ways the heroes can take apart the barricade. They can easily destroy the barrier with their weapons, but this makes a great deal of noise and alerts the monsters in Area 5 of the heroes’ approach.

They can also try to take the barricade apart quietly by rolling a @Check[type:crafting|dc:15]{Crafting Skill Check} or @Check[type:thievery|dc:15]{Thievery Skill Check}. Their effort removes the barricade whether they succeed or fail, but if they fail, they make enough noise to alert the enemies in @UUID[.mJ3pVc1aJi98duaA]{Area 05}. If they succeed, they avoid alerting the monsters.

If you're using the Enhanced maps, there might be additional tools you can use to make this moment as smooth as possible. Make sure to read the informational box below to find out more!

Doors

 Knowledge Base: Walls

Here, the players are faced with an obstacle which inhibits movement and vision further down the tunnel to the north. You might notice a door icon on the map over the barricade- that's because this barricade is a door!

Doors in Foundry

In Foundry VTT, doors are simply a type of wall that can be opened by players or GMs that click on the icon. They can have the same traits as other types of walls- they block any combination of light, sound, vision, and movement, or none of them. Doors also have some extra options that normal walls can't- you can lock doors so that players can't open them, or even hide their icon from players to make "secret" doors that only the GM can open. To see these settings for yourself, you can navigate to the walls layer on your toolbar (the temple icon), and then double right-click on any wall node.

Clearing the Barricade

In this case, this wall is already preconfigured for you. It's "secret", which means it can only be seen or opened by the GM, and it blocks both movement and vision. Players will need to succeed a skill check to clear the barricade, at which point you simply need to remove it to let them pass. On the original maps, you can do this by simply clicking on the door icon.

If you're using our enhanced map, you also have the option of going a little further. We've included a tile on the scene that can be swapped out when the barricade is dismantled. We've even provided a macro to do it for you! When run, it plays a sound effect, determined by whether your party dismantled the barricade noisily or quietly. Then, after a short delay, it swaps out the tile and opens the door at the same time.

To use the macro, you need only click here @Macro[saQTdI63wy22v5yk]{Area 04 - Barricade} and begin narrating how your players bypass the obstacle as the sounds play in the background.

Other Doors In This Adventure

There's a locked door in @UUID[.UCEZLyerntYnmzgX]{Area 07}, and there are similar obstacles to the barricade in @UUID[.2KRdW68qNXeJ6JpN]{Area 12} and @UUID[.CMjhAWaRWlbFVoF0]{Area 15} which both have macros provided as well.

Experience Points

If the heroes quietly take apart the barricade, award them each 10 XP.

Forgotten Crypt.name: 被遗忘的墓穴 Forgotten Crypt
Forgotten Crypt.text:
这个房间里有许多不死生物，如果玩家不够小心的话，这将是一个非常危险的遭遇。当英雄们进入该区域时，大声朗读以下内容：

在路障的另一边，洞穴长廊蜿蜒向下延伸，尽头是一个古老的墓穴，被一把诡异的蓝色火炬点亮。墙壁上排列着壁龛，每个壁龛里都有一个腐烂的木棺材，而房间中央有一个加高的平台，上面放着一个石棺。

音频提示 Audio Cue

你可以在这里播放环境音的“邪恶的死者 The Malevolent Dead”来警告玩家们他们走进了一个什么样的地方。考虑到也许有些GM想吓他的玩家们一跳，该音效没有被预布置在场景上，GM可以在音效列表里播放它。

这个地穴里住着邪恶的不死生物，它们会爬起来攻击任何愚蠢到打扰它们安眠的生物。如果玩家在@UUID[.Ccp3c9A1WH9tOCVO]中突破路障时发出了很大的声音，那么骷髅和丧尸就已经从它们的棺材中爬了出来，并准备好战斗了。但如果英雄们在打开路障的时候是安静的，那么不死生物们就还躺在他们的棺材里，当英雄们一进房间，不死生物们就掀开棺材盖子，战斗就开始了。在这种情况下，每个不死生物必须在他们的第一个回合中使用他们的第一个动作来站立（Stand）。

就像其他战斗一样，首先让玩家投掷先攻检定，也为为丧尸和骷髅分别进行先攻检定。

和不死生物战斗 Undead Fight

@Actor[5H8ZX7y5IkUBhvhF]{4个骷髅守卫 Skeleton Guards}，@Actor[0plBflWwrCWQO2RO]

不死生物能力 Undead Abilities

这些不死生物拥有特殊的规则来影响他们承受的@UUID[JournalEntry.OoPjlnYYGLn5KPZy.JournalEntryPage.9H0Jrj0siUcpFC1s]。骷髅的伤害抗力可以减少它们受到的伤害。每当骷髅受到其抗力条目中所列类型的伤害时，其所受到的伤害将扣掉被抗力抵消的数值。丧尸则拥有弱点，它们以相反的方式工作。当丧尸受到弱点中所列的任何类型的伤害时，将其所受伤害加上弱点后面所列的数字。

这两种类型的不死生物拥都有免疫，可以防止某些类型的伤害和技能影响它们。它们不会受到任何带有心灵特征的效果影响，它们不会受到毒素伤害，它们不会失去意识——甚至免疫带有非致命特征的效果。

FVTT可以自动地计算免疫，弱点和抗力的伤害变化。当你选中一个生物时点击消息栏中的伤害按钮就可以把伤害应用导该生物上。

丧尸还有一种特殊能力叫做缓慢，它代表了他们笨拙而缓慢的移动方式。由于它永久处于@Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]，丧尸每回合只能使用2个动作，而不是3个，而且不能使用反应动作！

经验值 Experience Points

这场战斗特别具有挑战性！不死生物被摧毁之后，奖励每个英雄100XP。

失落的宝藏 Lost Treasure

@Actor[sRzrLrMdVXKZjkFA]

战斗结束后，英雄们有时间环顾房间寻找宝藏。墙上的诡异的蓝色火炬是一种特殊的魔法物品，被称为长明水晶，它会不断地发光。虽然它看起来像火，但它不散发热量，也不会被熄灭！

此外，其中一具骸骨的下葬时还配有打磨光滑的盾牌，盾牌的形状看起来像咆哮的狮子头。它可以作为盾牌使用；因为它是一件精美的艺术品，英雄可以以5gp的价格出售它。

如果玩家们拿走了火炬，记得点击左侧工具栏里的光线控件然后右键房间里的灯泡图标关掉光源以表示玩家拿走了火炬。



原文:

This chamber contains a number of undead creatures, and it could make for a very dangerous encounter if the players aren’t careful. When the heroes enter this area, read the following aloud.

Beyond the barricade, an old cavern corridor winds down into the earth, ending in an ancient burial vault lit by a strange glowing crystal emitting a blue flame. Alcoves line the walls, each one containing a rotten wooden coffin, while the center of the room has a raised platform holding a stone sarcophagus.

Audio Cue

The audio track "The Malevolent Dead" can be played here to give your players some warning of what they are about to walk into. It has not been placed on the scene as an Ambient Sound to allow those GMs who wish to surprise their players with the undead to do so.

This crypt holds foul undead creatures that rise to attack any living thing foolish enough to disturb their slumber. If the players made a lot of noise breaking through the barricade in @UUID[.Ccp3c9A1WH9tOCVO]{Area 04}, the skeletons and zombie have already broken free from their coffins and are standing, ready for a fight. But if the heroes were quiet when they took apart the barricade, the undead are still in their coffins, and combat begins when they push aside their lids as soon as the heroes enter. In this case, each undead must use their first action on their first turn just to Stand.

Like for the other fights, first ask the players to roll Perception for initiative. The skeletons and zombie also roll Perception for initiative.

Undead Fight

@Actor[5H8ZX7y5IkUBhvhF]{4 Skeleton Guards}, @Actor[0plBflWwrCWQO2RO]{Zombie Shambler}

Undead Abilities

These undead have special rules that affect how they take @UUID[JournalEntry.OoPjlnYYGLn5KPZy.JournalEntryPage.9H0Jrj0siUcpFC1s]{Damage}. Skeletons have some damage resistances, reducing incoming damage of certain types as listed on its character sheet above, while Zombies have weaknesses and are especially vulnerable to certain damage types.

Both types of undead also have immunities that prevent certain types of damage and abilities from affecting them. They aren't affected by anything with the mental trait, they don't take poison damage, and they can't fall unconscious- even from effects with the nonlethal trait.

Foundry VTT can automatically calculate the effects of immunities, weaknesses, and resistances when applying damage. When you have a creature selected, you can click on the buttons on a damage roll's chat card to apply it to your controlled creature!

Zombies have one more special ability called Slow that represents their ponderous, staggering movements. Due to being permanently @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed}, A zombie can use only 2 actions on its turn each round instead of 3, and can't use reactions at all!

Experience Points

This fight is especially challenging! For destroying the undead creatures here, award each hero 100 XP.

Lost Treasure

@Actor[sRzrLrMdVXKZjkFA]{Forgotten Crypt}

After the fight, the heroes have time to look around the room for treasure. The glowing crystal is a special magic item called an everlight crystal that emits light constantly. Although it looks like fire, it emits no heat and can't be extinguished!

In addition, one of the skeletons was buried with a polished shield carved to look like a roaring lion. It can be used as a shield, or the heroes can sell it for 5 gp due to its fine artistry.

If the players take the crystal, remember to turn off the light in the room by going to lighting layer (the light-bulb icon on the toolbar) and right-clicking it.

Forgotten Shrine.name: 被遗忘的神龛 Forgotten Shrine
Forgotten Shrine.text:
从通道中很难看到这个小神龛的门，因为高台距离地面约有10尺高。英雄必须成功通过一次@Check[type:athletics|dc:10]{运动 技能 检定}才能爬上高台。当英雄们进入房间时，大声朗读以下内容。

古老的木门在生锈的铰链上吱嘎作响地打开，露出一间破败的密室。霉菌和腐烂污蚀了每一个表面。在房间的远端是一座巨型乌贼石像，它的触手伸向密室中央的祭坛。污垢几乎覆盖了一切，但却没有触及放在石祭坛上的银碗。碗里的水清澈见底。

如果玩家询问有关神龛的事，让他们进行一次@Check[type:religion|dc:15]{宗教 技能 检定}。如果成功，他们会认出这座神龛是献给自然与海洋之怒的神祇——哥兹莱的。如果有人在密室中施放侦测魔法，他们会感知到魔法的存在。

银碗中的水纯净而清洁，但它带有一丝哥兹莱的魔法。任何饮用碗中水的人都会恢复[[/r 1d8 #healing]]点生命值，但他们必须进行一次@Check[type:fortitude|dc:20]{强韧 豁免}。

如果失败，他们会感到海浪在胃中翻涌，这使他们在接下来的一个小时内感到恶心。在这一小时结束前，他们所有的d20掷骰、护甲职业以及法术DC都会受到-1状态减值。（你可以从下方的说明框中将此减值效果拖动到他们的指示物上。）

如果强韧豁免成功，他们会感到海洋的力量在体内涌动。在接下来的一个小时内，他们可以调用海洋之力来强化自己以抵御伤害。这种力量是一个反应动作，英雄可以在受到攻击的大成功或大失败重击时使用。此能力会将大成功或大失败成功转变为普通成功（因此该攻击造成正常伤害而非双倍伤害）。

每位英雄每天只能获得一次碗的益处；在一天内饮用第二次没有效果。如果将碗移出此神龛，它将失去所有魔法，但可以以5金币的价格出售。

Pathfinder第二版：效果

@Item[XnvGgsstWwDeunij] @Item[od9RY509l6WGFawA]

有时要追踪具有不同持续时间和触发条件的各种效果可能会很困难。为了帮助你和你的玩家记住祝福（或诅咒）的持续时间，你可以通过从这里拖动效果到他们的角色卡或指示物上来应用这些效果——强韧豁免失败的角色使用“海水恶心”，成功的角色使用“海洋之力”。

除了用于追踪持续时间外，效果还可以对你的角色属性应用修正。例如，上面链接的海水恶心效果会自动对角色的检定和DC应用一个状态减值。



原文:

The door to this small shrine is hard to see from the passage, as the ledge is about 10 feet off the ground. A hero must succeed at a @Check[type:athletics|dc:10]{Athletics Skill Check} to climb up to the ledge. When the heroes enter the room, read the following aloud.

The ancient wooden door creaks open on rusty hinges, revealing a ruined chamber. Mold and rot stain every surface. On the far side of the room is stone statue of a giant squid, its tentacles reaching toward an altar in the center of the chamber. The scum covers almost everything, but it hasn’t touched the silver bowl sitting atop the stone altar. The water in the bowl is perfectly clear.

If the players ask about the shrine, ask them to roll a @Check[type:religion|dc:15]{Religion Skill Check}. If they succeed, they identify the shrine as one dedicated to Gozreh, the god of nature and the fury of the ocean. If anyone casts detect magic in this chamber, they sense the presence of magic.

The water in the silver bowl is pure and clean, but it carries a touch of Gozreh's magic. Anyone who drinks from the bowl regains [[/r 1d8 #healing]] Hit Points, but they must roll a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:20]{Fortitude Save}.

If they fail, they feel the ocean's waves crash through their stomach, which makes them feel sick for the next hour. They take a -1 status penalty to all d20 rolls, their Armor Class, and spell DCs until the hour has passed. (You can drag this penalty effect to their token from the instructional box below.)

If they succeed at the Fortitude save, they feel the power of the ocean surge through them. In the next hour, they can call upon the ocean's might to fortify themself against harm. This power is a reaction that the hero can use when hit by a critical hit on an attack. This ability turns the critical success into an ordinary success (so the attack deals normal damage instead of double damage).

Each hero can get the bowl's benefits once per day; drinking a second time in a day has no effect. The bowl loses all of its magic if removed from this shrine, but can be sold for 5 gp.

Pathfinder Second Edition: Effects

@Item[XnvGgsstWwDeunij] @Item[od9RY509l6WGFawA]

Sometimes it can be difficult to keep track of effects with different durations and triggers. To help you and your players remember the duration of the blessing (or the curse), you can apply these effects to their characters by dragging them from here to their character sheet or onto their token- "Saltwater Sickness" for characters that failed their fortitude save, and "Ocean's Might" for characters that succeeded.

As well as being used to track durations, effects can also apply modifications to your character's stats. For instance, the Saltwater Sickness effect linked above will automatically apply a status penalty to the character's checks and DCs.

Abandoned Storeroom.name: 废弃储藏室 Abandoned Storeroom
Abandoned Storeroom.text:
环境音 Ambient Sounds

 知识库：环境音

当你的玩家到达这个房间时，他们可能会注意到一些狗头人尝试撬开牢笼时发出的噪音。FVTT可以将音效配置在地图上，而且里音源越近，这些声音就会越来越响。当狗头人注意到玩家们时，你可以点击左边工具栏的环境音控件然后右键房间里的喇叭图标来关掉这个音效以表示狗头人因为注意到了玩家而停下了手中的活。

这间屋子里有一小群叫做狗头人的小型类人生物。大声朗读下面的句子。

这个大房间看起来曾经是地面上某栋建筑的仓库。在房间另一端，你们可以看到一个以前可能是笼子或牢房的地方，但现在里面装满了板条箱和木桶。四个长得像蜥蜴一样、体型有人那么大的生物聚集在牢门周围，正试图撬开它。

这些狗头人正忙着撬开牢房，他们没有注意到英雄的进入，但当有人移动到任何狗头人的10英尺范围内时，他们会转过身来，咆哮并攻击——所有人进行先攻检定！

遭遇 Encounter

@Actor[r9w1n85mp9Ip4QiS]{4个狗头人战士 Kobold Warriors}

夹击 Flanking

这里的狗头人是狡猾的敌人，会使用战术和特殊能力来获得优势。当移动时，狗头人会试图站在一个英雄的两侧，从英雄的侧面夹击。一个被夹击的英雄会对所有参与夹击的狗头人陷入@Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]（AC遭受-2环境减值）。

你可以在攻击结果的消息里看到这项减值。

狗头人有一种叫做偷袭的特殊能力，这能让他们攻击措手不及的目标时造成额外1d4伤害。英雄可以在他们的回合中通过走位来避免被夹击，或当其中一个狗头人生命值降低至0时夹击结束。

经验值 Experience Points

击败了狗头人的话，奖励每位英雄80XP。

上锁的仓库 Locked Storage

@Actor[yFRBdjHLEsCU66sI]

战斗结束后，英雄们可以检查敌人的尸体。一些狗头人带着从渔场偷来的鱼干，很明显他们也参与了盗窃，但是丢失的鱼显然远不止四只狗头人身上带的那么多。

这个房间里的宝藏就在锁着的钢铁牢房里。英雄可以用两种方式打开这个铁栅栏门。他们可以借助一套盗贼工具，通过@Check[thievery|dc:15]检定来开锁——成功即可打开牢门！你可以右键点击锁上的门来解锁它，使得你的玩家可以打开门。另外一种方法是，英雄可以通过一次成功的@Check[athletics|dc:25]检定}来破拆门。

牢房里有一堆旧板条箱和几个桶。虽然这些容器里大部分都只有高度腐烂的食物和污迹斑斑的布，但是其中箱子里有一小堆财宝：200sp，价值5gp的金戒指，和一把漂亮的+1短剑——一个魔法武器！使用此武器的英雄攻击检定+1！



原文:

Ambient Sounds

 Knowledge Base: Ambient Sounds

As your players approach this room, some of them might notice the faint sounds of the Kobolds trying to break into the cage. Foundry VTT's sound engine allows placed sound files to grow louder as tokens grow closer to them. When the kobolds notice the players, you can turn this sound off by switching to the Sounds layer of the scene and right-clicking the sound effect positioned on top of the kobolds.

This room has a small group of kobolds, small reptilian humanoids. Read the following aloud.

This large room looks like it was once a storeroom for a building above. At the far side, you can make out what might have been a cage or cell at some point, but it is now full of crates and barrels. Four lizardlike creatures the size of human children are clustered around the door to the cell, trying to pry it open.

These kobolds are so busy trying to open the cell that they don’t notice the heroes enter, but the moment someone moves within 10 feet of any of the kobolds, they turn around, snarl, and attack— have everyone roll for initiative!

Encounter

@Actor[r9w1n85mp9Ip4QiS]{4 Kobold Warriors}

Flanking

The kobolds here are cunning foes, using tactics and special abilities to gain an edge. When moving, the kobolds try to flank the heroes, standing on opposite sides of a single hero. A hero who is flanked has the @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} condition (giving it a –2 circumstance penalty to AC) to all melee attacks made by the flanking kobolds.

You should see this being taken into account by the system if you look at the AC comparisons in the attack result cards!

The kobolds have a special ability called sneak attack that lets them deal extra damage against off-guard heroes. A hero can stop being flanked on their turn by moving away from the kobolds, or if one of the kobolds is reduced to 0 Hit Points.

Experience Points

For defeating the kobolds, award each hero 80 XP.

Locked Storage

@Actor[yFRBdjHLEsCU66sI]{Abandoned Storeroom}

After the fight, the heroes can examine their foes. Some of the kobolds are carrying dried fish stolen from the fishery—clearly they were involved in the thefts, but more fish are missing than can be explained by four kobolds.

The treasure in this room is in the locked steel cell. The heroes can open this cell in either of two ways. They can use a thieves’ toolkit to roll a @Check[type:thievery|dc:15]{Thievery Skill Check} to pick the lock- it opens on a success! You can right-click the door to unlock it and allow your players to open it. Alternatively, they can force open the door, which requires a successful @Check[type:athletics|dc:25]{Athletics Skill Check}.

Inside the cell is a pile of old crates and a few barrels. While most of these contain long-spoiled food and stained cloth, one of them contains a small pile of treasure: 200 sp, a gold ring worth 5 gp, and a beautiful +1 shortsword—a magic weapon! The hero using this weapon increases their bonus to attack rolls by 1!

Trapped Hallway.name: 陷阱走廊 Trapped Hallway
Trapped Hallway.text:
这条短走廊里有一个简单的陷阱。当英雄们进入走廊时，请大声朗读以下内容。

这条短走廊有着光滑的精加工石墙，两端各有一扇门，不过远端的那扇门是关着的。地面铺着巨大的方形石砖。

这条走廊里有一个简单的陷阱，会向那些不注意脚下的英雄投落石块！

简单陷阱

@Actor[Z9ggO7spfHwr8up1]{落石陷阱}

当英雄们初次进入这条走廊时，要求每位玩家进行一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:20]{察觉 技能 检定}。如果有人成功，他们会注意到最靠近北门的那块方砖有些异样，仿佛地砖有些松动，并怀疑那里可能有陷阱。如果他们知道了陷阱的存在，英雄可以进行一次 @Check[type:thievery|dc:18]{盗法 技能 检定} 来解除装置，无论是通过卡住地砖还是支撑住天花板。如果成功，他们就解除了陷阱，英雄们可以正常通过走廊。如果失败，他们可以继续尝试，直到成功解除陷阱为止——但如果大失败，陷阱就会触发，天花板会砸在他们身上！

如果没有人注意到陷阱，当英雄第一次踏上触发位置（即最靠近北门的方砖）时，陷阱的反应就会发生。触发时，陷阱会从天花板掉落石块砸向英雄，对走廊里的每位英雄进行一次远程打击。如果这些打击中有任何一次是大成功或大失败命中，则会像任何打击一样造成双倍伤害。之后，陷阱不再具有威胁，英雄们可以继续他们的探索。

经验值

无论英雄们是解除了陷阱还是仅仅承受了它造成的伤害，奖励他们每人 8 XP。



原文:

This short hallway contains a simple trap. When the heroes enter this hallway, read the following aloud.

This short hallway has smooth walls of worked stone with a door at either end, though the door at the far end is closed. The floor is tiled with large, square stone tiles.

This hallway contains a simple trap that drops stone blocks onto heroes who don't watch their step!

Simple Trap

@Actor[Z9ggO7spfHwr8up1]{Falling Ceiling}

When the heroes first enter this hallway, ask each player to roll a @Check[type:perception|dc:20]{Perception Skill Check}. If anyone succeeds, they notice something strange about the square closest to the northern door, as though the floor tile were a little loose, and suspect that it might be trapped. If they know the trap is there, a hero can roll a @Check[type:thievery|dc:18]{Thievery Skill Check} to Disable a Device, either by jamming the floor tile or by bracing the ceiling. If they succeed, they disarm the trap and the heroes can move through the hallway normally. If they fail, they can keep trying until they manage to disable the trap—but if they critically fail, the trap goes off and the ceiling falls on them!

If no one notices the trap, its reaction happens the first time a hero steps on the trigger: the square closest to the north door. When triggered, the trap drops stone blocks from the ceiling onto the heroes, making one Ranged Strike against each hero in the hallway. If any of these Strikes are critical hits, they deal double damage, just like any Strike. Afterwards, the trap poses no further harm, and the heroes can continue their exploration.

Experience Points

Whether the heroes disable the trap or simply endure the damage it deals, award them each 8 XP.

Gold Puzzle.name: 金币谜题 Gold Puzzle
Gold Puzzle.text:
这个房间包含一个谜题。如果英雄们解开了谜题，他们可以获得额外的宝藏，并让他们的探索更加安全！当英雄们进入这个房间时，请大声朗读以下内容。

通往这个房间的门静静地滑开，露出一个长条形的房间。两尊祭司石像矗立在房间一侧的角落里，面对着一尊高大的男子雕像，他伸出双手，掌心向上。在这尊雕像前有一个石质祭坛，上面放着九枚金色的钱币。雕像中传出一个宏亮的声音。
“我以双手裁定所有财富的价值，举起其中更有价值的一方。这些钱币中有一枚是虚假的。仅通过两次裁定找出它，便可获得我的祝福。”

对雕像感到好奇的玩家可以尝试一次@Check[type:religion|dc:10]{宗教 技能 检定}技能检定。如果成功，他们会知道这座雕像描绘的是财富与文明之神阿巴达尔。

谜题

雕像和钱币代表了一个谜题。这里的挑战是辨别出哪枚钱币是假的。它们看起来完全一样，重量也完全相同，但假币的价值比其他的要低。向玩家解释，当英雄们将钱币放在雕像手中时，它会举起价值更高的那只手。因此，如果英雄们在每只手中各放四枚钱币，而右手包含假币，雕像就会举起左手。经过两次尝试后，雕像会要求英雄们指出假币。

如果他们未能指出假币，所有的钱币都会消失，并以随机顺序重新出现在祭坛上。如果钱币从祭坛上被拿走而没有放在手中，它们也会消失且谜题重置。任何添加到谜题中的真钱币都会立即消失，被添加到@UUID[.gz9x5HmzjSvvBLQp]{区域 10}的金库中。英雄们可以根据意愿尝试任意多次。未能解开这个谜题并不会阻止英雄们完成冒险，但由于@UUID[.KWTky7M63NvVIVRz]{区域 11}中的陷阱，这会使接下来的战斗更具挑战性。

如果他们成功了，真的钱币会掉到地板上，英雄们可以将它们作为宝藏带走（每枚价值1 gp），而假币则会变成铅。此外，通往区域 10的门会慢慢打开（你可以通过点击秘密门来开启并揭示该区域），这让英雄们可以许可获得阿巴达尔的宝藏，并允许他们调整区域 11中的陷阱使其对己方有利。

为玩家运行这个谜题时，告诉玩家他们必须决定如何称量编号为1到9的钱币，并秘密挑选哪个数字代表假币。如果他们未能指出假币并决定再次尝试，请挑选一个新的数字（因为谜题重置了）。玩家可能会在没有解开谜题的情况下意外选中假币，这也没关系——冒险者有时就是运气好！为了让这个谜题更简单，你可能需要提供道具，比如在每张纸上画一个硬币，并编号为1到9。

解法

解决这个谜题的诀窍是将钱币分成三组，每组三枚钱币。通过在每只手中各放一组（三枚），并将第三组留在祭坛上，玩家可以确定哪一组包含假币。如果一只手升起，另一只手就包含假币。如果两只手都没有升起，那么假币就在留在祭坛上的那三枚钱币中。英雄们随后需要对包含假币的那组重复此过程，在每只手中各放一枚硬币，并将第三枚留在祭坛上。如果一只手升起，另一只手中的硬币就是假币。如果两只手都没有升起，祭坛上的硬币就是假币。

经验值

并非所有的挑战都是危险的！如果英雄们解开了谜题，奖励他们每人80 XP。



原文:

This chamber contains a puzzle. If the heroes solve the puzzle, they can gain extra treasure and make their explorations safer! Read the following aloud when the heroes enter this room.

The door to this chamber silently glides open to reveal a long room. Two stone statues of priests stand in the corners along one side of the room, facing a towering statue of a man holding out both of his hands, palms up. In front of this statue is a stone altar holding nine golden coins. A voice booms out from the statue.
"In my hands I judge the value of all wealth, raising up whichever is greater. One of these coins is a deception. Find it using only two judgments and receive my blessing.”

Players curious about the statue can attempt a @Check[type:religion|dc:10]{Religion Skill Check} skill check. On a success, they know the statue depicts Abadar, the god of wealth and civilization.

The Puzzle

The statue and the coins represent a puzzle. The challenge here is to identify which of the coins is fake. All of them look identical and they all weigh exactly the same, but the fake coin is worth less than the others. Explain to the players that when the heroes place coins in the statue’s hands, it will raise the hand that has a higher value. So if the heroes put four coins in each hand and the right hand contains the fake, the statue will raise the left hand. After two attempts, the statue asks the heroes to identify the fake.

If they fail to identify the fake coin, all the coins vanish and reappear in a random order atop the altar. If the coins are taken from the altar and not placed in the hands, they also vanish and the puzzle resets. Any real coins added to the puzzle vanish immediately, added to the vault in @UUID[.gz9x5HmzjSvvBLQp]{Area 10}. The heroes can try again as many times as they’d like. Failing to solve this puzzle doesn’t prevent the heroes from completing the adventure, but it does make the next combat a bit more challenging because of the trap in @UUID[.KWTky7M63NvVIVRz]{Area 11}.

If they succeed, the real coins fall to the floor and the heroes can take them as treasure (each is worth 1 gp), while the fake coin turns to lead. In addition, the door to Area 10 slowly swings open (you can reveal this area by clicking on the secret door to open it), which gives the heroes access to Abadar’s treasure and allows them to adjust the traps in Area 11 to work in their favor.

When running this puzzle for the players, tell the players they must decide how they want to weigh coins numbered 1 through 9, and secretly pick which number represents the fake coin. If they fail to identify the fake coin and decide to try again, pick a new number (since the puzzle resets). The players might accidentally pick the fake coin without solving the puzzle, and that’s okay—adventurers get lucky sometimes! To make this puzzle simpler, you might want to provide props, like pieces of paper with a coin drawn on each one, numbered 1 through 9.

The Solution

The trick to solving the puzzle is to split the coins into three groups of three coins each. By placing one group of three in each hand and leaving the third group on the altar, the players can determine which group contains the fake coin. If one hand rises, the other hand contains the fake. If neither rises, then the fake is in the three coins that were left on the altar. The heroes then need to repeat this process with the group containing the fake, by placing one coin in each hand and leaving the third on the altar. If one hand rises, the coin in the other hand is the fake. If neither rises, the coin on the altar is the fake.

Experience Points

Not all challenges are dangerous! If the heroes solve the puzzle, award them each 80 XP.

Abadar’s Vault.name: 阿巴达尔的宝库 Abadar’s Vault
Abadar’s Vault.text:
通往这个房间的门是由石头制成的，这使得它无法被打破或强行打开。打开这扇门的唯一方法是解决@UUID[.bpVEaN8PUCgbuJvk]{区域 09}中的谜题。如果玩家完成了这一壮举，门就会打开。在这种情况下，请大声朗读以下内容。

这个小房间里有一个印有钥匙符号的旧木箱。在木箱后面是一个由齿轮和滑轮组成的巨大装置，看起来像是某种看不见的装置的内部构造。

这个房间里有阿巴达尔的祝福，以及@UUID[.KWTky7M63NvVIVRz]{区域 11}中陷阱的控制机构。

虽然英雄们第一次进入时房间是黑暗的，但他们可以看到北面墙上射来的微弱光束。墙上的小洞让他们可以窥视区域 11。在那个区域的远端，有一个狗头人正在放哨。如果英雄们倾听，他们可以听到视线之外的其他几个狗头人之间断断续续的轻声交谈，谈论着“老大的新宠物”和“上面的城镇”的计划。

阿巴达尔的祝福

@Actor[8PgsPDw5TjD2dUTr]{阿巴达尔的宝库}

未上锁的箱子里装有阿巴达尔的祝福。里面有一堆钱币，一张卷起的羊皮纸，以及一个装着一颗祖母绿的小玻璃盒。这些钱币包括 214 cp、22 sp 和 3 gp，加上英雄们在区域 9的谜题中损失的任何钱币。英雄们还可以将祖母绿以 20 gp 的价格出售。

这张羊皮纸是一张力场弹幕卷轴。奥术或神秘施法者（如标志性法师艾兹伦）可以使用此卷轴施放法术力场弹幕，而无需消耗法术位，甚至不需要准备它。一旦使用，卷轴就会化为灰烬。

控制机构

如果英雄检查箱子，他们会注意到从箱子背面伸出的一个杠杆。让他们进行一次@Check[type:crafting|dc:15]{手艺 技能 检定}。如果英雄成功，他们会意识到这个机构控制着隐藏在区域 11中的陷阱，尽管从这里他们无法准确判断陷阱是如何触发的或它的作用。

杠杆目前处于“解除”位置。如果英雄将其设置为“激活”位置，区域 11中的陷阱就会激活。

经验值

有时英雄们可能会因为采取动作使以后的事情变得更容易而获得经验值。如果英雄们找到了杠杆并将其设置为激活陷阱，请为他们的成就奖励每人 30 XP。



原文:

The door leading into this chamber is made from stone, making it impossible to break or force open. The only way to open this door is to solve the puzzle in @UUID[.bpVEaN8PUCgbuJvk]{Area 09}. If the players accomplished this feat, the door is open. In that case, read the following aloud.

This small chamber contains an old wooden chest emblazoned with the symbol of a key. Behind the chest is a massive contraption of gears and pulleys that looks like the inner workings of some unseen device.

This chamber holds the blessings of Abadar and the control mechanism for the traps in @UUID[.KWTky7M63NvVIVRz]{Area 11}.

Although the room is dark when the heroes first enter, they can see tiny shafts of light coming from the wall on the north side. Tiny holes in the wall allow them to peek into Area 11. On the far side of this area is a kobold, standing watch. If the heroes listen, they can hear fragments of a quiet conversation between a few other kobolds, out of sight, talking about "the boss's new pet" and plans for "the town above."

Abadar's Blessings

@Actor[8PgsPDw5TjD2dUTr]{Abadar's Vault}

The unlocked chest contains the blessing of Abadar. Inside is a pile of coins, a rolled-up piece of parchment, and a small glass box containing a single emerald. The coins consist of 214 cp, 22 sp, and 3 gp, plus any coins that the heroes lost to the puzzle in Area 9. The heroes can also sell the emerald for 20 gp.

The piece of parchment is a scroll of force barrage. An Arcane or Occult spellcaster (like the iconic wizard, Ezren) can use this scroll to cast the spell force barrage without expending a spell slot or even having it prepared. Once used, the scroll crumbles to dust.

Control Mechanism

If a hero examines the chest, they notice a lever protruding from the back of it. Have them roll a @Check[type:crafting|dc:15]{Crafting Skill Check} check. If the hero succeeds, they realize that this mechanism controls a trap hidden in Area 11, though from here they can’t tell precisely how the trap is triggered or what it does.

The lever is currently set to the “disarmed” position. If the heroes set it to the “active” position, the trap in Area 11 activates.

Experience Points

Sometimes the heroes might earn XP for taking actions to make things easier later on. If the heroes find the lever and set it to activate the trap, give them each 30 XP for their accomplishment.

Kobolds and Traps.name: 狗头人和陷阱 Kobolds and Traps
Kobolds and Traps.text:
这个房间里有更多被称为狗头人的带鳞片蜥蜴人，以及一对致命的陷阱。当英雄们进入这个房间时，大声朗读以下内容。

门嘎吱一声打开，露出一个看起来像大厅的巨大房间。在远端，一排宽阔的阶梯通向曾经可能是王座的地方。柱子支撑着高耸的天花板，曾经作为装饰的横幅残片依然悬挂其上。房间中央的地面上，透过污垢可以看到装饰性的瓷砖图案。

致命陷阱

这次 遭遇 包含两种不同类型的陷阱，它们可能会 攻击 角色——或者狗头人！当英雄第一次 时代 移动到陷阱 区域 旁边时，让他们进行一次 察觉 检定。如果他们的总值高于该陷阱“察觉”条目中的DC，英雄就会注意到陷阱并可以避开该 区域。

如果他们知道陷阱的位置，位于陷阱 区域 旁的英雄可以花费 2 个 动作 进行一次贼活 检定 来解除该 危害。此 检定 的DC列在陷阱的“解除”条目中。记住，如果他们大失败，陷阱就会触发！

遭遇

@Actor[4Axci50gPQArPg7d]{狗头人陷阱大师} @Actor[r9w1n85mp9Ip4QiS]{狗头人 战士 (2)} @Actor[j8qD2LVDSP2lhLUO]{中间矛陷阱} 

中间矛陷阱

这个房间里的第一个陷阱是中间矛陷阱。只有当英雄们将 @UUID[.gz9x5HmzjSvvBLQp]{区域 10} 的杠杆设置为“激活”时，此陷阱才会生效。否则，它没有 效果。

这个陷阱影响该房间的部分地面。如果陷阱处于激活状态，第一个踏入白色轮廓 区域 内瓷砖的 生物 将触发陷阱——而这极有可能是狗头人，因为他们没意识到英雄们已经激活了陷阱！陷阱从西墙射出长矛，对每一排的第一个 生物 进行一次远程打击。与之前的陷阱不同，这个陷阱有一个“重置”条目——如果未被解除，它会在 1 分钟后重置，并在下一次 时代 有 生物 移动到轮廓 区域 时再次发射。

狗头人圈套

狗头人 陷阱大师也有她自己的陷阱——她可以布置作为移动陷阱的圈套。她将它们布置在轮廓 区域 东侧阶梯顶部的三个方格中。你可以使用 @Actor[X1ZVzivrcAqbNDq2]{尖刺陷阱} 角色来标记它们的位置。一旦布置好，这些圈套可以被拆除，但不能重复使用——一旦触发，它们就不再是威胁。

狗头人战术

两名 狗头人 战士和一名 狗头人 陷阱大师驻守在这里。所有三名狗头人都接到命令，要确保没有人能到达下方的 狗头人 巢穴。

狗头人会听到开门时的嘎吱声，所以一旦英雄们进入房间，狗头人们就准备好战斗了。分别为 狗头人 战士和陷阱大师掷 先攻（使用 察觉）。

两名战士在战斗开始时位于通往底层的螺旋楼梯两侧，但他们会在自己第一个 回合 开始时移动并封锁楼梯。如果英雄们使用 区域 10 的控制机制激活了中间矛陷阱，狗头人们在移动到轮廓 区域 以封锁楼梯的那一刻就会触发该陷阱。更多信息请参见上方的 中间矛陷阱。

狗头人 陷阱大师留在原地，在第一轮花费她所有的 动作 来布置她最后一个小型尖刺陷阱（当PC进入房间时，另外两个已经布置好了）。一旦最后一个陷阱布置完成，她就会使用长矛从远处 攻击 英雄，直到他们靠近。

经验值

为了奖励克服房间内的狗头人和危害，给每位英雄 136 XP。

奇怪的珠宝

击败狗头人后，玩家可以检查倒下的敌人。狗头人的 道具 列在他们的数据板块中。

狗头人 陷阱大师戴着一条特殊的项链：一条简单的铜链和一个巨大的蛋壳碎片。蛋壳呈象牙色，但上面有奇怪的绿色纹路。这块碎片只有约 3 英寸宽，但产下它的蛋一定至少有 2 英尺宽。即使英雄们把这块碎片带回镇上，也没有人能辨认出什么样的 生物 会产下如此巨大的蛋，尽管塔米莉推测它可能来自巨型海龟或其他爬行动物。英雄们稍后在地下城中会有机会了解更多关于这枚奇怪蛋的信息。

准备下去？

击败狗头人后，英雄们可以拿走他们的财物（记录在每个 生物 的 数据表 中）。英雄们在房间里不会发现其他 宝藏，但还有另一个出口：房间后方的螺旋楼梯通往地下更深处。

这是英雄们 休息 并恢复法术和生命值，然后继续前进的绝佳 时代。你应该提醒他们这个选项，并鼓励他们回到 奥塔里 报告他们的发现。他们也可以利用这段 时代 出售发现的任何 宝藏 并购买额外的 道具。

如果英雄们向 塔米莉·坦德威尔 报告在洞穴中爬行的带鳞生物，她会被他们在渔场下方发现的故事所震惊，并恳求英雄们继续前进，终结这个威胁。她能辨认出这些生物是狗头人，一种喜欢陷阱的小型爬行类人生物，通常为更强大的生物效力。她还指出，失踪的鱼量远超几个狗头人所能吃掉的。塔米莉担心城市下方有某种更饥饿的东西，并向英雄们表达了她的担忧。

如果玩家到目前为止在 冒险 中感到特别吃力，你也可以利用这个机会给他们一点帮助。塔米莉存有两瓶 @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.2RuepCemJhrpKKao]{治疗} 药水以备急需。喝下其中一瓶药水的英雄立即恢复 [[/r 1d8[positive]]] 点生命值。如果英雄们同意继续 探索，塔米莉会很乐意将两瓶药水都送给他们。

切换场景

 

当你的玩家准备好前往楼下时，你需要将他们的指示物移下去。通过拖动框选 玩家 指示物，然后按 ctrl+c（macOS 为 cmd+c）复制指示物。然后，右键点击 第二层 地图并选择“激活”来激活它。

场景加载完成后，移动到地图南侧的 @UUID[.2KRdW68qNXeJ6JpN]{区域 12：还是狗头人和陷阱}，将鼠标悬停在楼梯附近的 区域 上，然后按 ctrl+v（macOS 为 cmd+v）将 玩家 指示物粘贴到位。



原文:

This chamber holds more of the scaly lizard-people called kobolds, plus a pair of deadly traps. When the heroes enter this room, read the following aloud.

The door opens with a creak, revealing a massive chamber that looks like an audience hall. On the far side, a broad set of stairs leads up to where a throne might once have been. Pillars support the high ceiling, and the ruined tatters of once decorative banners still hang from them. A decorative tile pattern centered in the middle of the room shows through the grim coating the floor.

Deadly Traps

This encounter includes two different kinds of traps that might attack the characters—or the kobolds! The first time a hero moves next to a trapped area, have them roll a Perception check. If their total is higher than the DC in the Notice entry for that trap, the hero notices the trap and can avoid that area.

If they know the trap’s location, a hero next to a trapped area can spend 2 actions to roll a Thievery check to disable that hazard. The DC of this check is listed in the trap’s Disable entry. Remember, if they critically fail, the trap goes off!

Encounter

@Actor[4Axci50gPQArPg7d]{Kobold Trapmaster} @Actor[r9w1n85mp9Ip4QiS]{Kobold Warriors (2)} @Actor[j8qD2LVDSP2lhLUO]{Central Spears} 

Central Spears

The first trap in this chamber is the central spears trap. This trap is active only if the heroes set the lever in @UUID[.gz9x5HmzjSvvBLQp]{Area 10} to “active.” Otherwise, it has no effect.

This trap affects part of the floor in this chamber. If the trap is active, the first creature to step on a floor tile in the white-outlined area triggers the trap—and it’s most likely the kobolds, who don’t realize the heroes have activated the trap! The trap shoots spears from the western wall, making a ranged Strike against the first creature in each row. Unlike the earlier trap, this trap has a Reset entry—if it’s not disabled, it resets after 1 minute and fires again the next time a creature moves in the outlined area.

Kobold Snares

The kobold trapmaster also has traps of her own- snares which she can set up as mobile traps. She sets them on the three squares located at the top of the stairs just to the east of the outlined area. You can use the @Actor[X1ZVzivrcAqbNDq2]{Spike Trap} actor to mark where they were placed. Once set up, these snares can be disarmed, but they can’t be reused—once they go off, they’re no longer a threat.

Kobold Tactics

Two kobold warriors are stationed here, along with a kobold trapmaster. All three kobolds have orders to make sure that no one reaches the kobold lair below.

The kobolds hear the door creak as it opens, so as soon as the heroes enter the room, the kobolds are ready to fight. Roll initiative (using Perception) for the kobold warriors and the trapmaster separately.

The two warriors start the combat at either side of the spiral staircase leading down, but they move to block the stairs at the start of their first turn. If the heroes activated the central spears trap using the control mechanism in Area 10, the kobolds set off that trap the moment they move into the outlined area to block the stairs. See Central Spears above for more information.

The kobold trapmaster stays where she is, spending all of her actions on the first round to lay down her last small spike trap (the other two are already down when the PCs enter the room). Once the final trap is placed, she uses her spears to attack the heroes from afar until they approach.

Experience Points

For overcoming the kobolds and the hazards in this room, give each hero 136 XP.

Strange Jewelry

After defeating the kobolds, the players can examine their fallen foes. The kobolds’ gear is listed in their stat blocks.

The kobold trapmaster is wearing a special necklace: a simple copper chain and a cracked piece of a large eggshell. The shell is ivory in color, but it has strange green veins running through it. This piece is only about 3 inches across, but the egg it came from must have been at least 2 feet wide. Even if the heroes take this piece back to town, no one can identify what sort of creature would lay such a massive egg, although Tamily speculates that it might have come from a giant turtle or another reptile. The heroes have the chance to learn more about this strange egg later in the dungeon.

Going Down?

After defeating the kobolds, the heroes can take their belongings (noted in each creature’s stat block). The heroes won’t find other treasure in the room, but there’s another exit: the spiral staircase in the back of the room descends even deeper into the earth.

This is a great time for the heroes to rest and regain their spells and Hit Points before pressing onward. You should remind them of this option and encourage them to head back up to Otari to report what they discovered. They can also use this time to sell any treasure they’ve found and purchase additional gear.

If the heroes report to Tamily Tanderveil about the scaly creatures creeping around the caverns, she’s shaken by the story of what they found underneath her fishery, and she implores the heroes to press on to put an end to this menace. She can identify the creatures as kobolds, small reptilian humanoids who have a fondness for traps and are often seen in the service of more powerful creatures. She also notes the amount of fish that has gone missing is far greater than what could have been eaten by a handful of kobolds. Tamily is worried that there’s something far hungrier beneath the city, and she shares her concern with the heroes.

If the players have had a particularly hard time with the adventure thus far, you can also use this opportunity to give them a bit of help. Tamily has a pair of @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.2RuepCemJhrpKKao]{Potions of Healing} stored away in case of emergency. A hero who drinks one of these potions immediately regains [[/r 1d8[positive]]] Hit Points. Tamily gladly gives both potions to the heroes if they agree to continue their exploration.

Changing Scenes

 

When your players are ready to proceed downstairs, you'll need to move their tokens down. Select the player tokens by dragging a box over them, and copy the tokens by pressing ctrl+c (cmd+c for macOS). Then, activate the Floor 2 map by right clicking on it and choosing "Activate".

Once the scene finishes loading, move to @UUID[.2KRdW68qNXeJ6JpN]{Area 12: Kobold Lookouts} in the south of the map, hover your mouse over the area near the stairs, and press ctrl+v (cmd+v for macOS) to paste the player tokens in place.

Kobold Lookouts.name: 狗头人哨兵 Kobold Lookouts
Kobold Lookouts.text:
第二层

地牢第二等级的挑战比第一等级更危险。在探索这一等级的过程中，玩家将了解到鱼群失踪背后的真相。城市下方的一群狗头人最近孵化出了一只角龙雏龙，并一直在袭击奥塔里渔场，以为他们不断成长的看护对象提供稳定的饮食。如果英雄们不打败这个威胁，这条龙长大后可能会给奥塔里镇带来法术毁灭！

如果玩家希望击败狗头人和龙，他们必须发挥出所有的技能和能力。与第一等级一样，除非另有说明，否则这一等级的房间都没有照明。狗头人都拥有黑暗视觉，几乎不需要光亮。

如果你还没有这样做，请激活地图的第二等级以吸引玩家的注意力，并将英雄的指示物放置在这一区域的楼梯上。

狗头人准备了这个房间来抵御任何入侵者，并部署了两名更精干的守卫来保卫这里。因为他们正躲藏着，所以先不要显示他们的指示物。当英雄们走下螺旋楼梯时，大声朗读以下内容。

楼梯螺旋向下深入地底，最后通向一个看起来专门为抵御入侵者而准备的房间。在房间的一侧，一张桌子被侧翻过来以提供掩蔽，而在另一侧，板条箱和木桶堆叠在一起，形成了第二道屏障。

隐藏的狗头人

狗头人斥候在遭遇开始时处于隐藏状态。询问每位玩家他们的察觉 DC：即他们的察觉 + 10。然后投掷一个 d20 并加上狗头人的隐秘值。如果总值等于或高于英雄中最高的察觉 DC，英雄们在狗头人发动攻击之前不会注意到他们——房间看起来是空的！不要在地图上显示指示物，直到狗头人发动攻击、移出路障，或者直到英雄绕过路障足以看到躲藏的狗头人。但如果任何英雄的察觉 DC 高于狗头人的隐秘检定总值，狗头人就会被发现！在地图上显示他们的指示物。

无论哪种情况，请玩家投掷先攻（除非英雄正在躲藏，否则使用察觉）。使用狗头人隐秘检定的总值作为他们的先攻。如果任何英雄在狗头人之前进行回合，但狗头人成功隐藏了自己，英雄们知道附近有敌人，但不知道在哪里——他们必须进行@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{寻觅}来寻找敌人。

遭遇

@Actor[rPaHIh0ICnTLnRO6]{2 狗头人斥候}

狗头人战术

如果狗头人的回合在隐藏状态下开始，他们会向一名英雄发射十字弩。该角色在对抗该攻击时具有@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}状态，这使他们的 AC 受到 -2 状态减值，并允许狗头人通过其偷袭攻击能力造成额外伤害。在这次远程打击之后，狗头人不再处于隐藏状态（如果你还没有显示他们的指示物，请显示），战斗正常进行。

经验值

由于战胜了房间里的狗头人，奖励每位英雄 80 XP。

发臭的路障

音频提示

在玩家突破路障后，你可能希望开始播放第二层浸水的路口播放列表。这将为你的玩家提供流水声，并标志着氛围的变化。

在这个房间的后面有一个临时路障。如果英雄检查这个路障，要求进行一次@Check[type:perception|dc:10]{察觉 检定}。如果总值为 10 或更高，他们会注意到路障后面的通道传来一股恶臭——就像腐烂的鱼和汗水的味道。如果总值为 20 或更高，他们还会听到远处传来微弱的滴水声。

如果英雄拆除这个路障，在开启通道之前询问他们是将其拆毁还是小心地拆卸——就像在@UUID[.Ccp3c9A1WH9tOCVO]{区域 04}中一样。其他房间里的生物离得太远，听不到英雄们发出的任何噪音，但英雄们无从得知这一点！

同样，就像在区域 04中一样，我们提供了另一个宏，你可以用来自动拆除路障。要运行它，只需点击@Macro[pb7k8V9m7cFioy6B]{区域 12 - 路障}。



原文:

Floor Two

The challenges in the second level of the dungeon are more dangerous than those in the first level. In their explorations of this level, the players will learn the truth behind the missing fish. A band of kobolds under the city has recently hatched a horned dragon wyrmling, and have been raiding the Otari Fishery to provide a steady diet for their growing charge. If the heroes don’t defeat this menace, the dragon might grow up to spell doom for the town of Otari!

The players will have to use all their skills and abilities if they hope to defeat the kobolds—and the dragon. As with the first level, unless noted otherwise, the chambers in this level aren’t lit. The kobolds all have darkvision and have little need for light.

If you haven't already done so, activate the second level of the map to bring your players' focus to it, and place down their heroes' tokens on the staircase in this area.

The kobolds prepared this room to defend against any intruders and stationed two of their more capable guards to defend this place. Because they're hiding, don't reveal their tokens just yet. When the heroes descend the spiral staircase, read the following aloud.

The stairs spiral down deep into the earth before ending in a chamber that looks like it’s been prepared specifically to defend against intruders. On one side of the room, a table has been turned on its side to provide cover, while on the other, crates and barrels have been piled up to create a second barrier.

Hidden Kobolds

The kobold scouts begin this encounter hidden. Ask each player to tell you their Perception DC: their Perception + 10. Then roll a d20 and add the kobolds' Stealth. If the total is equal to or higher than the highest Perception DC from the heroes, the heroes don't notice the kobolds before they attack- the room looks like it's empty! Don't reveal the tokens on the map until the kobolds attack or they move out from behind their barricades, or until a hero moves around the barricades enough to see a hiding kobold. But if any hero's Perception DC is higher than the total of the kobold's Stealth check, the kobolds are spotted! Reveal their tokens on the map.

Either way, ask the players to roll initiative (using Perception unless a hero was hiding). Use the total from the kobolds' Stealth check for their initiative. If any heroes have their turn before the kobolds but the kobolds successfully hid themselves, the heroes know there are foes nearby, but they don't know where- they'll have to @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} to find their enemies.

Encounter

@Actor[rPaHIh0ICnTLnRO6]{2 Kobold Scouts}

Kobold Tactics

If a kobold's turn starts while they're hidden, they fire their crossbow at a hero. That character has the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} condition against the attack, which gives them a -2 status penalty to AC and allows the kobold to deal extra damage from their sneak attack ability. After this ranged Strike, the kobold is no longer hidden (reveal their tokens if you haven't already), and the fight proceeds normally.

Experience Points

For overcoming the kobolds in this room, award each hero 80 XP.

Smelly Barricade

Audio Cue

After your players breach the barricade, you may wish to start the Floor 2 Soggy Crossroads playlist. This will provide your players with the sounds of running water and denote a change in atmosphere.

There is a makeshift barricade in the back of this room. If the heroes examine this barricade, ask for a @Check[type:perception|dc:10]{Perception Check}. If the total is 10 or higher, they notice a foul stench coming from the passage behind the barricade—like rotten fish and sweat. If the total is 20 or higher, they also hear a faint sound of dripping water coming from somewhere in the distance.

If the heroes take this barricade apart, ask them if they tear it down or carefully disassemble it before you open the pathway-just like in @UUID[.Ccp3c9A1WH9tOCVO]{Area 04}. The creatures in the other rooms are too far away to hear any noise the heroes make, but the heroes have no way of knowing that!

Again, just like in Area 04, we've provided another macro you can use to automatically dismantle the barricade. To run it, just click @Macro[pb7k8V9m7cFioy6B]{Area 12 - Barricade}.

Soggy Crossroads.name: 浸水的路口 Soggy Crossroads
Soggy Crossroads.text:
在这个交叉路口，英雄们可以选择自己想要先走哪边。

越过路障，通道蜿蜒曲折。地面缓慢地下降，很快就淹没在一汪浅水里。水似乎从通道的右边流过来，在那个方向，水面上跳跃着蓝色的闪光。主通道则越过地板上积水的凹坑继续向左延伸，一股难以抵挡的恶臭从左侧拐弯处飘来。

来自@UUID[.7Ko4GJeI1K3Vy1Xp]的光微微闪烁，渐渐消失，仿佛是水面的倒影。如果玩家停下来研究一会儿，他们会注意到倒影中微弱的火光，但这些火光似乎在更远的地方。英雄们在这里停下仔细聆听的话，也注意到主通道远处传来微弱的咆哮声@UUID[.CMjhAWaRWlbFVoF0]。



原文:

This intersection offers the heroes a choice of which way they’d like to go first.

Beyond the barricade, the passageway meanders briefly. The floor descends slightly and soon becomes flooded by a shallow pool of water. The water appears to be flowing out of a passageway to the right, and a shimmering blue light in that direction reflects off of the water there. The main passageway continues to the left, over the slight depression in the floor where the water has pooled. An overpowering stench drifts from around a bend.

The light coming from @UUID[.7Ko4GJeI1K3Vy1Xp]{Area 14} shimmers and fades, as if it were a reflection off the water. If the players stop to study it for a while, they notice faint glimmers of firelight in the reflections, but these seem further away. Heroes who stop to listen here also note a faint growling noise coming from further up the main passageway- @UUID[.CMjhAWaRWlbFVoF0]{Area 15}.

Elements of Chaos.name: 混乱的元素 Elements of Chaos
Elements of Chaos.text:
当英雄们进入房间时，大声朗读以下内容。

在水坑的另一边有一个奇怪的房间，里面充满了神奇的能量。脉动的魔法球漂浮在房间的三个角落里。西南部的球体是用褐色的泥土和石头做成的，而东北部的球体看起来像是用玻璃做成的，旋涡状的云在里面流动；远处角落里的圆球燃烧着熊熊的火焰。在火焰球对角的位置，散落着破碎的残骸，水从这里流出来，流向西北。

虽然英雄们可能想要了解更多关于这个房间的信息，但他们必须首先处理被困在这里的生物：当英雄们进入房间时，一个完全由火焰构成的元素生物便会从火焰之球里出现。

音频提示 Audio Cue

当遭遇开始时，播放【全都烧起来了 Everything Is Fire】可以提示玩家他们现在所处的情景。

这个房间的魔法召唤了一个看起来像老鼠的小型元素生物，它身体完全由燃烧的煤炭和阴燃的火苗组成。它不能下水，所以被困在这里大部分时间内都躲在火焰之球里。当第一个角色穿过水域进入这个房间时，火球就会粉碎，煤渣鼠就会发起攻击。让玩家进行先攻检定。

为了开始遭遇，你可以使用@Macro[iPvtf4ZGr6qX8OnF]，它会将地图上的球体自动替换成破碎的，播放一个对应的音效，且将煤渣鼠的指示物改为可见。你需要做的事仅为给煤渣鼠们骰先攻！

遭遇 Encounter

@Actor[hiGwRWdxAsoCII4f]

烟雾和隐蔽的生物 Smoke and Concealed Creatures

煤渣鼠能释放出在它身体周围持续放出烟雾。这能给予它@Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]状态，使它难以被攻击命中。每当英雄尝试进行法术攻击或以打击命中老鼠时，首先让玩家进行一次纯骰检定——不受到任何加值的D20掷骰。如果骰出5或更高，则英雄可以正常命中，如果骰出4或更少，则攻击失手。

烟雾还会呛到周围的生物，使他们进行强韧豁免并产生效果。

持续伤害 Persistent Damage

每当煤渣鼠击中英雄，英雄就会着火！这会造成持续性伤害，这是一种特殊类型的伤害，不会立即发生。相反的是，英雄会在他们的回合结束时受到[[/r 1d4[persistent,fire]]]（并非煤渣鼠的回合）。然后英雄可以尝试一个纯骰检定（没有任何加值的情况下投掷一次D20），看看火是否熄灭——如果结果是15或更高，则火焰就熄灭了！如果没有，他们将在下一轮结束时再次受到伤害（每次受到伤害时投掷1d4），然后进行新的纯骰检定。这在每次回合结束时都会发生，直到火焰熄灭。

英雄还可以用其他的方式来灭火。英雄可以花费一个动作来扑灭火焰。当他们这样做时，他们可以立刻一次纯骰检定，效果如上所述。英雄也可以尝试跳进水坑里（在这个房间里很容易能找到），虽然会陷入到底状态，但火焰会自动熄灭。

经验值 Experience Points

如果英雄遭遇并击败了煤渣鼠，奖励每位英雄80XP。

元素之助 Elemental Aid

在与煤渣鼠战斗完之后，英雄们可以调查另外两个元素球体。两者都是完整的，看起来相对稳定。如果有人在这个房间里施展侦测魔法，他们就能感知到魔法的存在。

空气球中充满了旋涡状的云；如果有人触碰它，一阵风就会充满整个房间，传来一阵风吹般的耳语。它说：“召唤风来获得我的祝福，在天空翱翔吧。”这给了英雄们一种特殊的能力，每个人可以在接下来的24小时内使用1次。通过花费1个动作呼唤风力量，英雄们可以用下一个动作飞行最多40尺远。他们必须在坚实地表上结束移动——如果他们不这样做，他们会坠落并受到相当于落并距离一半的钝击伤害。

如果英雄们碰触岩土球，他们会听到研磨声和轰隆声，就像巨石从山上坠落一般。在这嘈杂的声音中，他们听到另一个声音说：“呼唤大地，获得它的神力。”英雄们将获得第二个技能，每个人可以在接下来的24小时内使用1次。通过花费1个动作呼唤大地的力量，英雄突然涌出力量，所有的近战打击伤害都将造成额外2点伤害。此效果一直持续到英雄的下一回合开始。

元素球的魔法效果能生效1次。如果玩家再次回到这里，元素球只会沉默，不会提供任何好处。

追踪效果 Tracking Effects

@Item[5GOQjPjCvdRjdLIu] @Item[QhskhZjYTuD5IDfs]

你可以将效果拖到玩家的指示物上来提醒大家祝福的存在。



原文:

When the heroes enter the room, read the following aloud.

On the far side of the puddle of water is a strange chamber, crackling with magical energy. Pulsing orbs float in three of the four corners of this room. The orb in the southwest is made of brown earth and stone, whereas the one in the northeast looks to be made of glass, and is filled with a swirling cloud. The orb in the far corner holds a roaring flame; opposite that orb are shattered remains and the water that flows down the passageway to the northwest.

While the heroes might want to learn more about this room, they must first deal with the creature trapped here: an elemental made of pure fire that emerges from the fire orb as soon as the heroes enter.

Audio Cue

Once the encounter has started, the Soundboard Loops track "Everything is Fire" should be useful in indicating to your players the danger of being close to the Cinder Rat.

The magic in this room summoned a small elemental creature that looks just like a rat, made up entirely of burning coal and smoldering flame. It can't go into the water, so it's trapped here and spends most of its time hiding within the fire orb. As soon as the first character passes through the water into this room, the fiery orb shatters and the cinder rat attacks. 

To start the encounter, you can use the @Macro[iPvtf4ZGr6qX8OnF]{Area 14- Cinder Rat} macro. It will replace the orb on the map with a broken one, and play a sound effect, while also revealing the cinder rat's token. All you need to do is roll for initiative!

Encounter

@Actor[hiGwRWdxAsoCII4f]{Cinder Rat}

Smoke and Concealed Creatures

The cinder rat emits a cloud of smoke around itself, as described in the Fetid Fumes ability. This gives it the @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition, making it hard to hit with attacks. Whenever a hero attempts a spell attack roll or Strikes the rat, first ask the player to roll a flat check—a d20 roll with nothing added. If the die comes up with a 5 or higher, the hero can attack normally. If the roll is a 4 or less, the attack misses.

The smoke also chokes nearby creatures, forcing them to make fortitude saves to avoid choking.

Persistent Damage

Whenever the cinder rat hits a hero, that hero catches on fire! This deals persistent damage, a special type of damage that doesn’t happen right away. Instead, that hero takes [[/r 1d4[persistent,fire]]]{1d4 persistent fire damage} at the end of their turn (not the rat’s turn). The hero can then attempt a flat check (roll a d20 without adding anything) to see if the fire goes out—if the result is a 15 or higher, the flames are extinguished! If not, they’ll take the damage again at the end of their next turn (rolling 1d4 each time they take this damage), and then roll a new flat check. This happens at the end of every turn until the fire goes out.

There are other actions a hero can use to put out the fire. A hero can spend an action to pat out the flames. If they do, they can roll a flat check right away, before they take the damage, as described above. A hero might also think to go jump in the puddle of water. If they drop to the ground in a square filled with water (gaining the prone condition), the flames go out automatically.

Experience Points

If the heroes encounter and defeat the cinder rat, award each hero 80 XP.

Elemental Aid

After the fight with the rat, the heroes can investigate the other two orbs. Both are intact and appear to be relatively stable. If anyone casts detect magic in this chamber, they sense the presence of magic.

The air orb is filled with a swirling cloud. If anyone touches it, a rush of wind fills the room, carrying a voice like a whisper. It says, “Call upon the wind to gain my blessing and soar through the sky.” This gives the heroes a special ability they can each use once within the next 24 hours. By spending 1 action to call upon the wind, that hero can fly for their next action, moving up to 40 feet. They have to end the movement on solid ground—if they don’t, they fall and take bludgeoning damage equal to half the distance they fell.

If the heroes touch the earth orb, they hear grinding and grumbling, like boulders falling down a hill. In this cacophony, they hear another voice that says, "Call upon the earth to gain its strength." The heroes gain a second ability they can each use once within the next 24 hours. If a hero spends an action to call upon the earth, all their melee Strikes deal 2 extra damage from a sudden surge of strength. This bonus lasts until the start of the hero's next turn.

The orb's magical effects happen only once. If the players come back here again, the orbs are silent and don't offer any benefits.

Tracking Effects

@Item[5GOQjPjCvdRjdLIu]{Blessing of the Earth} @Item[QhskhZjYTuD5IDfs]{Blessing of the Air}

To help you and your players remember the duration and nature of these elemental blessings, you can apply these effects to their characters by dragging them from here to their character sheet or onto their token.

Xulgath Cave.name: 地蜥人洞穴 Xulgath Cave
Xulgath Cave.text:
这个房间是三个地蜥人的巢穴，他们是臭烘烘的爬行类人生物。大声朗读下面的句子。

这个房间里有一种令人难以抗拒的恶臭，就像臭鱼和汗液混合在一起。温暖潮湿的空气让恶臭更加浓烈。与之前的房间不同，这个房间看起来像是一个天然的洞穴，布满了钟乳石和石笋，一眼望不到尽头。

这个房间里可怕的恶臭来自于地蜥人，可以让其他生物觉得恶心。让每个玩家一进入房间就进行一次@Check[fortitude|dc:19]豁免}。任何成功的人都可以不受这种气味影响。未通过此豁免的英雄会陷入@Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]，所有D20掷骰结果和DC（包括他们的AC）都将遭受-1状态减值，直到他们花费1个动作呕吐出来。

遭遇 Encounter

@Actor[RTzFvmdSCf5yhguy]{3 地蜥人战士 Xulgath Warriors}

房间中央的爬虫类生物是地蜥人，类人的爬行动物，以生活在地底的大型家庭组成聚落，为争夺领土和资源而战斗。它们以其好斗的本性和可怕的恶臭而闻名——尽管它们自身对恶臭免疫。

惊讶的地蜥人 Surprised Xulgaths

这三个地蜥人正在为一块肉的归属争吵，没有注意到英雄们的到来。要求玩家进行先攻检定，而你以地蜥人的察觉为他们进行先攻检定。

地蜥人战术 Xulgath Tactics

地蜥人在战斗开始时是坐着的，并且没有拔出武器。他们目前陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]，直到他们花费一个动作@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OdIUybJ3ddfL7wzj]。他们还必须花费另外一个动作抽出木棒，才能进行攻击。一旦站起身并拔出木棒之后，地蜥人就会向前移动，以剩下的动作进行攻击。地蜥人会战斗至死。

经验值 Experience Points

如果英雄击败了房间内的地蜥人，奖励每人120XP。

宝藏 Treasure

@UUID[Actor.AkfRXhJ81gNlWhhR]

战斗结束后，英雄们可以检查一下地蜥人是否拥有宝藏。如果他们如此做，就能发现其中一个肮脏的生物的腰上绑着一个小袋子。袋子里有一些奇怪的金币，是在某个遥远的地下王国铸造的——金币的一面是地下洞穴中的一座塔，另一面看上去像个邪恶的精灵的头像。这些金币的价值相当于38sp和4gp。

为了让你的玩家获得Loot，你可以将房间里的小袋子指示物改为可见。

通往黑暗的通道 Passage into Darkness

除了英雄们进来的路，还有两条通道通向这个房间。一条从地图右边走出去，深入地下。这条隧道通向幽暗地域（Darklands），一个广阔的地下王国，地下深处充满了各种致命的生物和邪恶的怪物。这里是地蜥人的发源地，但这超出了这次冒险的范畴。

如果英雄们试图沿着这条路探索，需要告诉他们，经过一个小时的旅程，他们没有看到闯入渔场的生物的任何迹象，或许应该在迷路之前返回。幽暗地域是为更有经验的冒险者准备的，玩家在深入这些黑暗的国度之前应该先在地表进行冒险。

新挖的通道 Freshly Dug Tunnel

另一条通往这个房间的通道看起来是最近才挖的。这条隧道蜿蜒曲折，最后通向一堵由松散的石块和泥土砌成的薄壁。墙上有一个小洞可以让生物看到对面的房间（@UUID[.0vJpmu4QJ7RgYLi2]）。如果一个英雄向墙对面窥视，就可以看到那个区域的狗头人在进行他们的日常活动。如果他们花时间仔细聆听狗头人的谈话，英雄们能听到一些只言片语，包括“当我们偷走蛋的时候”和“给宠物更多的鱼”。想要破坏这堵墙的英雄可以尝试1次@Check[athletics|dc:20]检定。一但成功，他们就破墙而入！你可以点击@Macro[NAxPG4cHu4dKrx6h]来自动执行这个效果。

若失败，城墙仍然完好无损，并且区域17的狗头人会注意到响动并开始准备战斗。



原文:

This chamber is the den of a trio of xulgaths, which are smelly reptilian humanoids. Place the xulgath tokens as you'd like near the center of the cavern. Read the following aloud.

There is an overpowering stench in this chamber, like rotten fish mixed with oily sweat. The warm, humid air only adds to the foul atmosphere. Unlike the previous chambers, this one appears to be a natural cavern, dotted with limestone stalactites and stalagmites, making it hard to see where the room ends.

The horrid stench in this room comes from the xulgaths and can make other creatures sick. Have each player roll a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:19]{Fortitude save} as soon as they enter the room. Anyone who succeeds can ignore the smell. A hero who fails this saving throw is @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened}- they take a –1 status penalty to all their d20 rolls and DCs (including their Armor Class) until they spend an action to retch.

Encounter

@Actor[RTzFvmdSCf5yhguy]{3 Xulgath Warriors}

The reptilian creatures in the center of the room are xulgaths, reptilian humanoids who dwell underground in large family groups called clutches, fighting others for territory and resources. They’re known for their aggressive nature and their horrid stench—which they’re immune to.

Surprised Xulgaths

These three xulgaths are bickering with each other over a piece of meat and haven’t noticed the heroes. Ask the players to roll for initiative while you roll Perception for the xulgaths’ initiative.

Xulgath Tactics

The xulgaths start off combat seated without their weapons drawn. Until they spend an action to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OdIUybJ3ddfL7wzj]{Stand}, they’re @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} (taking a –2 circumstance penalty to their Armor Class). They also have to spend an action to draw their clubs before they can attack. Once they’ve stood and drawn their clubs, the xulgaths move forward to attack with whatever actions they have left. The xulgaths fight until slain.

Experience Points

If the heroes defeat the xulgaths in this room, award each hero 120 XP.

Treasure

@UUID[Actor.AkfRXhJ81gNlWhhR]{Small Bag}

After the fight, the heroes can check whether the xulgaths have any treasure. If they do, they find a small bag tied to the waist of one of the foul creatures. Inside the leather pouch is a handful of strange coins, minted in some faraway kingdom deep underground- the coins show a tower inside a cave on one side and a sinister-looking humanoid snake's head on the other. These coins amount to 38 sp and 4 gp.

To allow your players to loot them, simply reveal the "small bag" loot token which is placed next to the Xulgaths in the room.

Passage into Darkness

Two passages lead out of this room, other than the way the heroes came in. One leads off the map, heading steadily down, deep into the earth. This tunnel leads into the Darklands, a vast subterranean realm deep underground filled with all sorts of deadly creatures and sinister monsters. This is where the xulgaths came from, but it’s beyond the scope of this adventure.

If the heroes travel down this way, tell them that after an hour of travel, they see no sign of the creatures that broke into the fishery and should probably turn back before getting hopelessly lost. The Darklands are for more experienced adventurers, and the players should explore the surface more before delving into these lightless realms.

Freshly Dug Tunnel

The other passageway exiting this room looks like it was dug recently. This tunnel curves up and around before ending in a thin wall of loose stones and dirt. A tiny hole in the wall allows creatures to look into @UUID[.0vJpmu4QJ7RgYLi2]{Area 17} beyond. If a hero peeks through the wall, they can see the kobolds in that area going about their daily routines. If they spend time listening to the kobolds’ chatter, the heroes overhear a few phrases, including “when we stole the egg” and “more fish for the pet.” A hero who wants to break open this wall can attempt a @Check[type:athletics|dc:20]{Athletics skill check}. On a success, they break down the wall! As before, you can run the @Macro[NAxPG4cHu4dKrx6h]{Area 15 - Freshly Dug Tunnel} macro by clicking on it.

On a failure, the wall remains intact, and the kobolds in the Kobold Warren notice the sound and prepare for a fight.

Mermaid Fountain.name: 美人鱼喷泉 Mermaid Fountain
Mermaid Fountain.text:
这个房间里有一个暗藏的陷阱。当英雄们进入该区域时，大声朗读以下内容。

虽然这个长方形房间的大部分墙壁已经成为废墟，但中心的一座纯净的喷泉还完好无损，底部有什么东西在闪闪发光。喷泉中央是一尊大理石的美人鱼雕像，她噘着嘴，仿佛正在送出一个飞吻，又或者正在吹口哨。水池的每个角落都有某种镶嵌在石头上的机械装置，但西南角的那个似乎被砸坏了。

房间中央的美人鱼雕像是一个隐藏的陷阱的核心。当英雄进入房间时，要求每个玩家进行一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:20]{察觉 检定}。记下这些数值，因为之后你将要用这些结果作为他们的先攻。

如果有人检定结果大于等于20，则他们就能在陷阱触发前发现它。如果没有，英雄们就不会注意到任何异常情况。他们可以正常地行动，但如果有人踩到喷泉周围的地砖，陷阱就会被触发！

遭遇 Encounter

@Actor[v51J7K27abdDyLgJ]{美人鱼喷泉}

这个陷阱属于复杂陷阱，这意味着它像怪物一样行动。如果英雄触发了陷阱，用他们之前的察觉检定作为他们的先攻。你可以通过激活战斗追踪器并点击聊天框中检定旁边的交叉剑图标来完成此操作。喷泉则以隐秘检定进行先攻。

轮到喷泉中央的雕像回合时，它会旋转，从嘴里喷出一股高压水流。每一轮的效果都各不相同，而目标则是房间里的随机部位。在陷阱的“流程（Routine）”条目中详细描述了陷阱是如何工作的。

克服陷阱 Overcoming the Trap

英雄可以通过多种方式克服这个陷阱。如果有人在它触发前注意到了它，大家都避开喷泉旁边的方格，就可以安全地绕过陷阱。

一旦陷阱触发，英雄可以尝试解除位于水池每个角落的控制机关。只要这些机关中的其中一个仍然有效，陷阱就会继续在它的回合行动，但幸运的是，西南角的那个机关已经被砸坏了（只剩下其他三个机关需要解除）。要解除其中一个机关，英雄必须站在相邻的方格，花费2个动作并尝试 @Check[type:thievery|dc:20]{盗法 技能 检定}。如果成功，该机关将被解除。

英雄也可以通过攻击来砸烂剩下的三个机关（使用陷阱数据表中的AC和生命值）。这喷泉是大理石造的，拥有硬度。每次英雄击中机关时，需要将伤害值减去硬度，才能得到造成的实际伤害。

一旦所有的机关都失效了（无论被英雄们解除还是摧毁），陷阱就会停止运行，英雄便可以继续进行探索。

经验值 Experience Points

无论英雄们决定绕过喷泉，还是解除它，或者摧毁它，奖励每个英雄80 XP。

宝藏 Treasure

@Actor[xhyzSiXfoAxud376]{美人鱼喷泉}

一旦陷阱失效，英雄可以很容易地爬进喷泉并拿到钱币。水只有1尺深，虽然很冷，但并不危险。喷泉里的硬币总共有28 cp，8 sp，2 gp。

当玩家们找到一堆杂乱的钱币时，也许他们会想平均分配。你可以使用战利品表中的“分发钱币”按钮来在英雄之间分配现金，而无需自己进行任何计算！



原文:

This chamber contains a devious trap. When the heroes enter this area, read the following aloud.

While much of this rectangular chamber is in ruins, the center contains a fountain of pristine water with something glittering at the bottom. In the middle of the fountain is a marble statue of a mermaid, her lips pursed as if she were about to blow a kiss, or maybe whistle. Each corner of the pool has some sort of mechanism embedded in the stones, but the one in the southwest corner appears to be smashed.

The mermaid statue in the center of the room is the center of a devious trap. When the heroes enter the room, ask each player to roll a @Check[type:perception|dc:20]{Perception Check}. Take note of these results, because you'll also use them to determine the heroes' initiative.

If anyone's total is 20 or higher, they notice the trap before setting it off. If not, the heroes don't notice anything unusual. They can act normally- but if anyone steps on any of the tiles adjacent to the pool, the trap goes off!

Encounter

@Actor[v51J7K27abdDyLgJ]{Mermaid Fountain}

This trap is complex, which means it works like a monster. If the heroes trigger the trap, use the Perception results from before to determine their initiative. You can do this by activating the combat tracker and clicking on the crossed swords icon beside the roll in chat. The fountain rolls Stealth for its initiative.

On its turn, the statue in the middle of the fountain spins around, shooting a stream of high-pressure water from its mouth. The exact effects are different each round and target random parts of the room. The trap's Routine entry describes how this works.

Overcoming the Trap

The heroes can overcome this trap in a variety of ways. If someone notices it before it goes off and everyone avoids the squares adjacent to the fountain, they can safely bypass the trap.

Once the trap goes off, the heroes can try to disable the control mechanisms located at each corner of the pool. If any of these stones are still active, the trap continues to act on its turn, but fortunately for the heroes, the mechanism in the southwest corner has already been destroyed (leaving only those in the other three corners to deactivate). To deactivate a mechanism, a hero must stand in an adjacent square and spend 2 actions to attempt a @Check[type:thievery|dc:20]{Thievery Skill Check}. On a success, that mechanism is disabled.

The heroes can also physically destroy the three remaining mechanisms by attacking them individually (using the AC and Hit Points in the trap's stat block). The fountain, being made of stone, has Hardness. Each time a hero hits a mechanism, subtract this number from the damage roll before reducing the mechanism’s Hit Points.

Once there are no functioning mechanisms left, whether the heroes have disabled or destroyed them, the trap stops working, and the heroes can continue their exploration.

Experience Points

If they heroes bypass the fountain, disable it, or destroy it, award each hero 80 XP.

Treasure

@Actor[xhyzSiXfoAxud376]{Mermaid Fountain}

Once the trap is deactivated, a hero can easily climb into the fountain and get the coins. The water is only 1 foot deep, and while it's very cold, it's not dangerous. Inside the fountain are 28 cp, 8 sp, and 2 gp.

Often, when players find a stash of assorted coins, they'll want to split them equally. You can use the "distribute coins" button on the loot sheet to share the currency between your heroes without needing to do any calculations yourself!

Kobold Warren.name: 狗头人巢穴 Kobold Warren
Kobold Warren.text:
大部分狗头人居住在这里。当英雄们进入房间时，大声朗读以下内容。

门一打开，鱼腥味伴随着发霉的味道就飘了出来。在这个大房间的西侧有一张大桌子，两边都有长凳。桌子上摆满了吃剩的食物残渣，肮脏的餐具和破碎的盘子。在东边，墙上被掏出了一些洞穴，里面铺满了草席，当做小型卧室使用。这一定是狗头人的宿舍！

狗头人的据点 Kobold Placement

奥塔里地下的狗头人已经在这里安家了。这里有6个狗头人，但它们的确切位置取决于英雄在其他区域的行动。如果英雄发出很大噪音来打破@UUID[.CMjhAWaRWlbFVoF0]通向这里的薄墙，或者暴力破坏@UUID[.MSU45JsvJjOJc1dg]，把所有六个狗头人摆在房间中间，并准备战斗。如果英雄们保持安静，那么当英雄们进入房间时，狗头人毫无戒备。把其中三只放在桌子边，把另外三只放在卧室里睡觉。

不管狗头人在哪里，他们都不喜欢闯入者。他们会发起攻击！让所有玩家进行先攻，然后替狗头人进行察觉检定来决定它们的先攻顺序。

虽然所有的狗头人都在同一回合内轮流行动，但他们不会只专注于攻击一个角色。成对的狗头人可能会试图从侧面夹击一个英雄来触发他们的偷袭能力，而其他的人则会使用下面描述的非常规战术。

狗头人在与英雄们战斗时，会夸耀自己强大的血统和力量，并向那些“软皮肤”的英雄们保证，他们一定会后悔擅自闯入狗头人的领地。然而实际上，他们仍然和英雄们之前那些洞穴里打败的那些狗头人一样懦弱。

与英雄们之前遇到的敌人不同的是，最后一个幸存的狗头人会投降。

遭遇 Encounter

@Actor[r9w1n85mp9Ip4QiS]{6 狗头人战士 Kobold Warriors}

非常规战术 Unconventional Tactics

这些狗头人会在战斗中使用战术，例如在任何可能的情况下试图从侧翼夹击英雄。因为这里是它们的家，所以它们有一些其他技巧可以用来对付英雄。在整个战斗过程中使用这些战术来避免战斗重复乏味，让玩家保持专注！

  • 床垫掩护 Bed Cover: 在其中一个卧室里的狗头人可以花费1个动作从地板上立起一副稻草床垫并躲在后面。这样做能让它获得掩护@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.other-effects.I9lfZUiCwMiGogVi]，直到它们移动或直到它的下一回合开始。
  • 食物大战 Food Fight: 在桌子边的狗头人能花费1个动作捡起腐烂的食物残渣，然后扔向20尺内的一个英雄。这次一次+5的远程打击。如果攻击命中，它不会造成伤害，相反，英雄会陷入@Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]，直到他们花一个动作清理掉身上的食物。

  • 油腻攻击 Oil Attack: 在两个卧室之间的柜子里除了其他东西之外，还有三罐滑腻的油。狗头人必须花费一个动作打开柜子才能使用里面储存的油罐。一旦箱子打开，与柜子相邻的狗头人可以花费1个动作捡起并扔出其中一个油罐。这是一次+5 的远程打击。如果它命中一个英雄，那个英雄和他所在的方格就会被泼上一层滑溜溜的油。如果失手，油罐击中了英雄所在方格的地表，但是不会覆盖英雄。狗头人也能把油扔到一个空的方格内，让这个方格变得滑腻。
    在接下来的战斗中，满身油污的英雄们很难移动。每当他们行走时，他们必须尝试1次@Check[acrobatics|dc:10]检定。如果失败，他们会摔倒并陷入倒地状态。英雄可以小心的快步，只移动5尺而不用进行这次检定。
    任何试图通过覆盖油脂的方格的生物都必须成功尝试1次@Check[acrobatics|dc:10]检定，如果检定失败，则停止移动并摔倒在地。

经验值 Experience Points

因为战胜了房间里的狗头人，奖励每个英雄120XP。注意，英雄可以获得额外的经验值取决于他们要如何处理最后剩下的狗头人。

投降的狗头人 Kobold Surrender

当只剩下一个狗头人时，他会立即放下武器向英雄们投降，跪在地上用刺耳的尖声乞求宽恕。如果英雄们放过了狗头人，这个生物承诺会离开并且永远不再回来，但是它也会悄悄地补充说他用秘密来换取金币。

如果英雄们想套取狗头人的信息，那么他们有两种方法。第一种方法是付钱给狗头人。如果他们给狗头人10gp，它就会说出关于老大的事情，如果他们给狗头人20gp，他还会说出关于龙的事情。

但让英雄们放弃他们辛苦得来的财富并不是唯一的解决办法。英雄可以通过@Check[diplomacy|dc:10]检定来说服狗头人，或者用@Check[intimidation|dc:10]检定来恐吓狗头人，让他说出信息。如果英雄的检定结果为10或更高，他们能得知老大的信息。如果检定结果为20或更高，他们也能得知关于龙的信息。

关于老大 About the Boss: 狗头人会说这些关于他们老大的信息。

“佐尔甘老大是强大的狗头人首领，她强大的魔法可以把你活活烤熟！她总是很生气，对她的手下提出许多要求。尤其是现在，我们已经有了一位很强大的新朋友！”

关于龙 About the Dragon: 狗头人会说这些关于龙的信息。

“这个强大朋友是条龙，它是众神的给与的赐福，预示着狗头人注定要回到地表，征服这个可怜的人类小镇。等雏龙长大之后，我们就会夺回属于我们的东西！”

经验值 Experience Points

如果英雄们从投降的狗头人那里得知老大的信息，奖励每个英雄额外10XP。如果他们还得知了关于龙的信息，把这个奖励增加到30XP。

宝藏 Treasure

@Actor[1S486XWdfcEWYv6T]

一旦战斗结束，英雄们可以搜索宿舍的其余部分。这里的每个狗头人都戴着用铜链子串起来蛋壳项链，就像在@UUID[.2KRdW68qNXeJ6JpN]发现的那些一样。

除了狗头人的装备之外，还有一个收集来的装满饰品和贵重物品的箱子。里面有一捆精美的丝绸服饰价值5gp、一幅骑马的冒险家的画价值2gp、一个装满钱的小麻袋里面有20sp、一个装满陈年的酸葡萄酒的水晶瓶（水晶瓶价值1gp）、3罐油脂（减去狗头人在战斗中使用过的数量）、1个惊奇模型-梯子和一瓶治疗药水。



原文:

This chamber houses the majority of the kobold band dwelling here. When the heroes enter the room, read the following aloud.

As the door opens, the smell of rotten fish and mold wafts out. On the west side of this vast room is a large table with benches on either side. Old food scraps, dirty knives, and broken plates cover the table. Off to the east side, burrows have been dug into the wall to make small sleeping chambers filled with straw mats. This must be the kobolds' warren!

Kobold Placement

The kobolds beneath Otari have claimed this chamber as their home. Six of them are here, but their exact location depends on the heroes’ actions in other areas. If the heroes made lots of noise breaking through the wall between this area and the @UUID[.CMjhAWaRWlbFVoF0]{Xulgath den} or by destroying the mechanisms for the mermaid fountain trap in @UUID[.MSU45JsvJjOJc1dg]{Area 16}, place all six of the kobolds in the center of the room, ready to attack. If the heroes were quiet, the kobolds are relaxing when the heroes enter. Place three of them at the table, and put the other three in the sleeping alcoves.

Wherever the kobolds are, they're not happy about having visitors. They spring to attack! Ask each player to roll initiative, and roll Perception once to determine when the kobolds get their turn.

The kobolds don’t focus on any one character. Pairs of kobolds might try to flank one hero to use their sneak attack, while others use the unconventional tactics described below.

While fighting the heroes, the kobolds boast of their mighty lineage and combined power, assuring the “soft-skin” heroes that they’ll surely come to regret trespassing into the kobolds’ domain. However, they remain just as cowardly as the kobolds the heroes have already defeated in these caverns.

Unlike all the foes the heroes have faced so far, the last remaining kobold tries to surrender.

Encounter

@Actor[r9w1n85mp9Ip4QiS]{6 Kobold Warriors}

Unconventional Tactics

These kobolds use tactics in their fight, such as attempting to flank the heroes whenever possible. Since this is their home, they have a few other tricks they can use against the heroes. Use these throughout the fight to add variety and keep the players on their toes!

  • Bed Cover: A kobold in one of the sleeping chambers can spend 1 action to pull a sleeping mat off the floor and hide behind it. Doing so grants the kobold @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.other-effects.I9lfZUiCwMiGogVi]{Effect: Cover} until they move or the start of their next turn.
  • Food Fight: A kobold adjacent to the table can spend 1 action to pick up a scrap of rotting meat and throw it at a hero within 20 feet. This is a ranged Strike with a +5 attack modifier. If the Strike hits, it doesn’t deal damage. Instead, the hero is @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened} until they spend an action to clean the gross food off (no check needed).

  • Oil Attack: The chest between two of the sleeping alcoves contains, among other things, three jars of slippery oil. A kobold must spend an action to open the chest before they can use the oil stored inside. Once the chest is open, a kobold next to it can spend 1 action to pick up and throw one of these jars of oil. This is a ranged Strike with a +5 attack modifier. If it hits a hero, that hero and the square they’re in are coated in slippery oil. On a miss, the oil covers the ground but not the hero. The kobold can also throw the oil at an empty square to make just the square slippery.
    For the rest of the fight, a hero covered in oil has trouble moving. Each time they Stride, they must attempt a @Check[type:acrobatics|dc:10]{Acrobatics Skill Check}. If they fail, they fall over and gain the prone condition instead of moving. The hero can Step, moving only 5 feet, without this check.
    Anyone who moves through a square covered in oil must attempt a @Check[type:acrobatics|dc:10]{Acrobatics Skill Check}. If they fail, they stop moving and fall.

Experience Points

For overcoming the kobolds in this room, award each hero 120 XP. Note that the heroes can earn additional XP depending on how they handle the last remaining kobold.

Kobold Surrender

When only one kobold remains, he immediately drops his weapons and surrenders to the heroes, begging and groveling for his life with a raspy, high-pitched voice. If the heroes spare the kobold, the creature promises to leave and never return, but he also quietly adds that he's willing to share secrets in exchange for gold.

The heroes have two options if they want to learn what the kobold knows. The first is to offer the kobold the gold he requests. If they give the kobold 10 gp, he shares what he knows about the boss, and if they give him 20 gp (total, not in addition), he also shares what he knows about the dragon.

But parting with their hard-earned wealth isn't the only solution. A hero can try to persuade the kobold to share what he knows by rolling a @Check[type:diplomacy|dc:10]{Diplomacy} skill check, or they can bully the kobold with an @Check[type:intimidation|dc:10]{Intimidation} skill check.
